items.body: "There is no such thing as a stranger�s children." - old Ukrainian saying I�ve long been affected, indeed somewhat obsessed, by what�s happening in Ukraine, partly because of one of my favorite bands, DakhaBrakha. I went to Kyiv to see them at the time of the Maidan protests, just after the shooting by snipers of over a hundred protesters. I intentionally didn�t read this album�s booklet notes before listening, so that I could react to it without sympathetic pre-judgement, just as music. It�s strong musically and vocally by any standards, Ukrainian or otherwise. When I did then turn to the notes that translate and explain the songs, I had that rare experience, for me, of becoming moist-eyed. The songs are a mix of traditional and original. They are focused on the abduction by Russia of about 20,000 Ukrainian children who have been taken from their parents in Russian-occupied eastern Ukraine and sent to Russia, in an attempt to turn them into haters of their native land and people. It�s a heinous war crime. Marichka is a Ukrainian-Canadian singer who moves between Canada and her homeland. For this album she�s gathered two groups of musicians, one in each country. Both ensembles contribute vocals and instrumentation, mostly bowed strings, plus some bandura and piano. The group in Ukraine includes Lisa from the destroyed and invaded city of Mariupol, playing a solo on double ocarina; at 16 she was one of the stolen children but managed to return to Ukraine. Daughters of Donbas � co-led by Marichka and singer/bandurist Alina Kuzma, who shares the lead vocal role � is an all-female ensemble in Canada that tours performing these songs. �Foreign Land� is a reworking of a traditional song about the young girls who were sent away to work in foreign households - Marichka�s grandmother was one of these - that can also be taken to refer to the plight of today�s stolen children. The translation goes: A mother packed up her daughter To leave for a strange land To a strange land with strange people Oh, who will pity you, my daughter? Those who will beat me will pity me I'll never again live with you, my mother When, my daughter, should I expect you to come home? When the grass in the garden grows, my mother The grass grew and grew and began to dry The mother was waiting for her daughter to return, and began to cry Did you hear, my mother, how I came to you? How I flew as a bird above your window? How I cooed like a dove? If, my daughter, I could hear you I would open all the doors and windows To let you fly in Songs of Stolen Children by Daughters of Donbas, Alina Kuzma, Zo� Santo As befits the song, Marichka�s vocal here is gentle. But in the second track, �Rusalka,� with Alina Kuzma taking the lead vocals, things turn harsh and fierce. A rusalka is a mythical creature, a nature spirit of fields, forest and rivers, that features in traditional ritual songs. The melody of this one is by Zo� Santo and Kuzma, with lyrics drawing on tradition and the composition of Santo and 19thC Ukrainian poet and folklorist Taras Shevchenko. An ominous double-bass drone, chunking strings, a slithering vocal that moves into sections of white-voice fast recitative and expands into a soaring wild cry. The lyrics are very dark, perhaps evoking the hell of the front line: Home a hell of old growth stumps Marsh a mud of memories Don�t get bogged down in these parts Your kind won�t last a day in here While witches still fly, while roosters have yet to crow, Come here, something arises, �neath the oak something walks. A rusalka sat on a white birch, rusalky asked girls for shirts. Long fingers and nails so sharp Tongue forked round serrated teeth Moss grows down beneath her parts Weeds braided from ear to ear While witches still fly, while roosters have yet to crow, Come here, something arises, �neath the oak something walks. �Girls, my friends, give me your shirts. Though I�m thin, give me a thin one.� Here live us the backless ones Many voices of dead sons You are right to quake in fear Send your sinful children here �Who Am I� is a plea of separation and disorientation, the pain and confusion of an abducted child, contrasting �the human in me� and �the creature in me,� like an internalized riddle-song, with the refrain, in English: Who am I for you? Who am I for me? Do you know me? Really know me? �Enchantress,� passionately sung by Kuzma to her own bandura accompaniment, a girl�s lament of the loss of her brave love taken from her by the enchantress, who is an allegory of war, is based on a traditional song and uses that style of melody and lyrics, �Riddle,� sung by Marichka, reworks a traditional riddle song to be the riddles told by the grandfather of a child, 12-year-old Kira from Mariupol, who experienced the death of her father and her abduction to Russia. Her grandfather tracked her down, and brought her back, traumatized, and asked her riddles - as the notes say �to jog her memory, and remind her who she was, where her home was, and of her family�s love for her.� Songs of Stolen Children by Daughters of Donbas, Marichka �4.5.0� is a military expression for �all�s well� or �all is quiet.� The song is a message, as from a mother, to a stolen child. Marichka�s voice is cherishing: Remember this: I am with you, I am here Don't give up, I'm with you. Don't give up, I'm with you Your hope is my weapon Don't be sad, I'm with you 4.5.0. will be again �breaking into a tearing howl: And when the world's axis breaks When the sky folds like a parchment Out of nowhere her words will come� �and back to fragile reassurance �It's all right, I'm here, I'm here� "Lullaby," based on a traditional lullaby, sung by Alina Kuzma to accompaniment by her bandura and Zo� Santo's viola, starts in gentle lullaby style, but moves to a lament; it's for the stolen children and those who, as the notes put it, 'have been stolen for ever.' Songs of Stolen Children by Daughters of Donbas, Marichka �Remember, I Believe in You� is a powerful piece of harmonizing vocals and slithering strings. Here�s the story it�s based on: Yevhen lived in Mariupol with his three young children. During the siege they lived in a basement bomb shelter for months. One day, Russian soldiers entered their bomb shelter. Yevhen was taken to a filtration camp and separated from his children who were all taken to a hospital and then to Russian summer �camp�. In the filtration camp Yevhen was brutally tortured and forced to sleep standing on one leg. He tried to fall asleep, whispering prayers for his children: �Everything will be fine, I believe in you.� After his release he walked 30 kilometers to the place where his children had been taken but it was too late. They had already been sent to Moscow. Yevhen learned of this after receiving a text from one of his children who had found an unattended device. He traveled thousands of kilometers, crossed the borders of three countries, endured checks, interrogations and danger to reach Moscow and take his children home. All those days he tirelessly repeated to himself, �I believe in myself, I believe in my kids. Everything will be good.� �Another Heaven,� sung by Marichka with the ensemble in Ukraine, is inspired by another heart-rending story: Ilya was 9 years old when his mother was killed by a rocket strike right in front of him. He was taken to a hospital in occupied Donetsk, where 15 pieces of shrapnel were removed from his body without anesthesia. After he appeared in a report on Russian television, Ilya�s grandmother learned his location. She managed to bring her grandson to Kyiv, where he lives now, experiencing missile attacks every night. At age 11, he says that it is up to everyone to fight enemies, to protect other cities, and to build another heaven, where your home will not be destroyed. In 2014, during the Kyiv Maidan protests, Marichka wrote and performed �Red Boots Tango,� using a melody she�d put to a poem by Taras Shevchenko. For this album she sings it again in Ukraine, with the ensemble there adding swirling, classic tango-style strings. Songs of Stolen Children by Daughters of Donbas, BanduraGirl The final track on the album is a solo, recorded in Kyiv, by Anastasiya Voytyuk, accompanying herself on the older, simpler form of bandura that was used by kobzars to accompany epic poetry, and also on the nowadays more well-known big, heavy form developed from it in Soviet times that was made mainly in the piano factory at Chernihiv. Her song, �Soon I Will Be Back,� is based on a poem by novelist, journalist and war crime researcher Victoria Amelia, who was killed in 2023, in the city of Kramatorsk in Donbas, by a Russian rocket. Find the artist online. Further reading: Otava Yo - Do You Love (Review) Sofia Rei - Umbral (Review)

items._cn_summary: 这张作品以乌克兰传统民歌为基础，融合原创创作，聚焦俄乌冲突中被强行带走的约两万乌克兰儿童的悲剧主题。专辑由乌克兰裔加拿大歌手Marichka发起，联合加拿大与乌克兰两地的女性音乐人完成制作，乐器以弓弦乐器为主，加入班杜拉琴、钢琴及双陶笛。歌曲在传统与当代之间交替，从温柔抒情的母女离别叙事到以Rusalka（水泽精灵）为意象的激烈控诉，展现出从哀婉到愤怒的情绪光谱。歌词大量采用乌克兰语传统意象，将历史中被送往异乡做工的少女命运与今日被劫掠的儿童形成呼应。编曲以人声为核心驱动力，传统旋律线条清晰但情绪表达具有强烈的当代政治与人道主义色彩，是一张带有明确文化身份与历史创伤记忆的世界音乐作品。

items.body: Those of us who have been digging into Analog Africa�s increasingly formidable releases over the last two decades are well aware of the massive amount of raw, vodun-based Sato and Sakpata-derived funk the label has issued by Benin�s most prolific 1970s-era band, the Orchestre Poly-Ritmo. AA has dropped no fewer than 3 compilations of their heaviest material, as well as a reissue of the band�s first LP, in an effort to give them the international status they deserve. That being said, what might be different about this collection of their music? And who is Antoine Dougb�? Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa As it turns out, Dougb� was a song-conjurer whose mode of musical transfer was slapping his legs in a rhythm known as Cavacha, a groove created by drummer Belobi Meridjo, who was inspired by a train cadence that he worked into a pattern that ultimately spread like a 21st century California wildfire throughout Congolese pop music in the mid-1970s. Dougb�, known as the �Devil�s Prime Minister,� was also a practitioner of vodun who inspired fear in any musician he felt was unsuited to play his music, which is how he landed on working exclusively Poly-Ritmo, as he felt they could nail what he wanted in ways other bands couldn�t. His recording career was brief - 3 albums and a few singles - but as this collection shows, it was potent. Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa Because of the era from which this music dates, it�s not surprising that the recording and instrument tones have changed - the guitars have a plastic sheen and synthesizers appear- even if the music remains rooted in the 1970s. Perhaps the influence of the Cuban son is more apparent here than on other Poly-Ritmo collections, especially in the collection�s initial offerings. And yes, Congolese rumba, then shaking all of sub-Saharan Africa to its knees, is present too. �Ma Won Min Towe Leo� is one example. Opening with a bed of synthesizers, the shimmering guitars, tinny, seemingly squeezed dry by the 80s themselves, lock in over relentless high-hat-focused grooves. The guitars finally start firing in different directions midway through, before that synth weaves back in, forming a bed underneath it all. Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa �We Tayi Sin Assi Tche� is much more overtly Cuban. With its insistent cowbell, classic, nasal vocal call and response, and tight, repeated guitar figures, its debt to mid-twentieth century Afro-Cuban sons is transparent. Another track, �Djomido Ma Dougbe Tche� rides a groove reminiscent of 70�s-era Franco classic �Liberte.� The pulse is relentless, and the guitar solo repeats a tight repetition of a few notes, driving listeners to ecstasy all the while. However, none of this music is a mere copy of its influences; rather, like so much potent pop coming from the continent at the time, it is a swirl of major influences rendered by local rhythms and vocal phrasing to give it specific identity, in this case, to Benin. Dougb�s musical role on this collection is a bit murky. One of his three albums has a photo of him, fully mic�d behind a collection of hand drums, so perhaps he served as a percussionist/vocalist; this release never explains. He wasn�t a songwriter in the traditional sense. It seems he was more of an instigator and arranger, but his thumbprint was apparently heavy enough to warrant his name on the records he was involved with. Whatever the case, in his brief run as a recording artist, he and Poly-Ritmo produced a handful of driving, Cavacha-inspired grooves that can still wear holes in club floors. Further reading: Petrona Mart�nez - Ancestras (Review) Gnonnas Pedro & His Dadjes - Roi De L'Agbadja Moderne 1974-1983 (Review)

items._genre: African funk / Afro-Cuban / vodun music / world fusion
items._cn_summary: 本合辑收录贝宁歌手Antoine Dougbé与Poly-Rythmo乐队1977至1982年的合作录音，由小众厂牌Analog Africa发行。Dougbé被称为"魔鬼首相"，其音乐以拍击大腿的Cavacha节奏为核心，这一节奏源自鼓手Belobi Meridjo对火车节奏的捕捉，后蔓延至刚果流行乐。乐评详细追溯了Dougbé的伏都教信仰背景及其与Poly-Ritmo的独家合作关系，指出此合辑相较此前几张选辑的独特之处在于古巴son风格的影响更为明显，合成器与吉他交织呈现出80年代的质感，刚果伦巴元素亦有体现。以《Ma Won Min Towe Leo》和《We Tayi Sin Assi Tche》为例，前者以合成器铺垫配合闪烁吉他，后者则更直接地借鉴古巴音乐语汇，融合牛铃与应答式人声。作为世界音乐范畴的非洲放克文献，合辑展示了西非流行乐在70年代末向80年代初过渡时期的独特声响演变。

items.body: Editor's note: When this set of recordings came to me, I was at a loss as to how to share it. It's not music, in any traditional sense (although there is some freestyle rapping), and a 'review' of such an artifact of reality seems superfluous to the content. Instead, I asked sound recordist Ian Brennan if I could simply use his own brief commentary and the recordings he made on the street in Chicago. Twenty-five people afflicted by gun violence participated, many from the very block we�d setup on. Many neighbors were pulled-in spontaneously. Almost every one in the community had been impacted by violence somehow� both on the receiving and the inflicting end, and many both. One woman had just come from a memorial service, another was on her way. That�s how far-reaching the violence. Almost no one went untouched. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors By chance, we convened on the day that Trump ordered the deployment of the National Guard to the city. The recording took place on the front porch of the leader's ninety-four-year-old grandmother's house�right in the heart of the ��hood,� beneath the Midway Airport�s landing path. A pair of stray pitfalls stalked the block. But the grandmother warned not of gunshots, but the mosquitoes in her yard. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors We were in a section of town that one man defined as �the forgotten parts.� Just a short jaunt from the designer clothes shops and posh hotels of the city�s Magnificent Mile, the Southside spawned such legendary Blues artists as Muddy Waters, Willie Dixon, and Howlin� Wolf. Jazz musicians like Lionel Hampton and even Benny Goodman, hailed from nearby. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors The participants ranged in age from seventeen to sixty-seven, but the pattern held true. The person who�d asserted �you�ll really want to hear my story,� was the least compelling. The reluctant, the most moving. One elder�s tough facade broke down as she shared how she�d lost both her sons. She tearfully apologized, �I�m sorry. I�m sorry. I�m sorry.� But she had nothing to be sorry for. Society is the one that owes the apology� for the staggering statistical inequities of which no reasonable defense can be made. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors Editor's note: The full set of recordings are available on Bandcamp. Any profits from this project will be donated to Cure Violence Global , who states that their mission is "advancing an evidence-based health approach to end violence globally." When I asked him about the background sounds, producer Ian Brennan added, "No music is added. It�s all sounds from the source environment. I also ran loops/drones on a different track in the background as they spoke, and when they ended up being incidentally/somewhat magically/eerily synchronous, that is what was used for a few pieces with 'accompaniment' like some of the rap freestyles."

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑并非传统意义上的音乐作品，而是录音师Ian Brennan在芝加哥南区街头录制的枪支暴力幸存者的口述实录。录制地点位于一位九十四岁祖母家门前的前廊，靠近中途机场降落航道之下。参与者年龄从十七岁到六十七岁不等，二十五位社区居民分享了各自与暴力相关的经历，其中包含一些即兴说唱段落，但整体以人声讲述和环境声响为主。一位老人在讲述失去两个儿子的经历时情绪崩溃，反复道歉。编辑明确指出未添加任何音乐，所有声音均为现场实录。专辑收益将捐赠给致力于以公共卫生方法遏制暴力的Cure Violence Global组织。作品以田野录音与口述文献的形式呈现，捕捉了芝加哥南区被遗忘角落的真实声音景观，具有强烈的人类学与社会学价值。

items.body: Review by Second Life Syndrome — Originally written for theprogmind.comThe Emerald Dawn are back with Volume II of their epic, The Land, the Sea, the Air. The band has produced consistently, with increasing quality, over the past decade, and that continues here. This might be my favorite album from them (maybe second favorite after To Touch the Sky). Regardless, more people need to give them a shot.The Emerald Dawn comes to us from St. Ives, UK. They are four-strong, having the same lineup for the last seven years or so. The players are Ally Carter on guitars, soprano and tenor saxophones, and keyboards; Tree Stewart on vocals, keyboards, flute, handSonic, and Roli Seaboard; Dave Greenaway on 6-string bass, and Tom Jackson on drums.They play progressive rock that avoids the cliches. The songs are atmospheric and organic, not to mention quite lengthy. They sound like they could be straight out of the 70s, yet their sound is ever fresh to me simply because they don't really sound like anyone else. Their music is ethereal, mystical, spacious, and even a bit like a folk ritual at times.By now, everything about their sound is like comfort food for my soul: Ally's growling guitars, Tree's illustrious keys and flute, Dave's energetic bass, and Tom intricate drumming. There's a reason why all four of them end up in my top musician features every time they release an album: they are amazingly skilled players who value expression over technicality, authenticity over plasticity. And for my money? Tree has probably laid down the best keyboard performance of the year, swooning and flowing with clarity and majesty. All of the performances are incredible, though.The Land, the Sea, the Air (Vol II) follows the first volume from 2025, which I rather liked. But I think this one is stronger. It has only three songs, in true Emerald Dawn fashion. The first one is called 'Song of the Rainforest', which is twenty-one minutes long. And yet, it is one of my favorite songs by the band to this point. This lengthy instrumental piece is so atmospheric, but somehow also so groovy. The song pulls you into its foliage, and underneath those trees is plenty of searing synth, amazing sax segments, gorgeous melodies, and hypnotic portions that feel otherworldly. I particularly love the precious minutes towards the end that hover with smoky flute, like a spellbinding incense rich with emotion.The second track is 'Rivers of Tears', which is fifteen minutes long. This one took a little more time for me, but I've come to love the focus on piano. It has a bluesy, funk-oriented sound at times, and much of it is reserved and building towards something. The song is structured with more energetic portions in the middle and the end, and each half has its own character, one being piano expressions and the other being more sinister. It's a brilliant track.The final track is called 'Paradise', being about nine minutes long. And you know what? It's yet another favorite from the band. I can't get enough of it right now, actually. It's the most 'normal' song on the album, featuring great vocals from Tree, who also plays her cosmic heart out on the keys. Seriously, this track is both incredibly groovy, almost making me what to dance (almost), but the layers of keyboard melodies, the catchiness of the hook, and the final minutes of sheer instrumental glory are like celestial medicine for the mind. What a finish!The Emerald Dawn are seasoned musicians, yes, but they are passionate artists who truly feel the flow, taste the melody, visualize the color, hear the beating heart of it all. The Land, the Sea, the Air (Vol II) has some of their best work, both calming and foreboding at times. It is a balanced, well-written record that makes you want to start it over again as soon as it ends.
items._cn_summary: The Emerald Dawn 来自英国圣艾夫斯，这张专辑是乐队史诗计划《大地、海洋、天空》的第二卷，仅收录三首长篇作品，其中《雨林之歌》长达二十一分钟，为纯器乐曲目，氛围浓郁，融入了合成器、笛子与萨克斯的交织段落，带有民俗仪式感与冥想气质。第二首《泪之河》以钢琴为核心，融合蓝调与放克元素，结构上前后两段各具性格，一段偏向钢琴抒情，另一段偏向阴郁张力。终曲《天堂》约九分钟，同样是乐队擅长的长篇渐进叙事。整体音乐强调现场即兴般的演奏感与情感表达，避开类型化套路，在七十年代前卫摇滚传统中融入新鲜的声音纹理，但核心仍属渐进摇滚范畴，与实验、前卫或电子等深度实验方向存在一定距离。

items.excerpt: Deathrock has always had a practical relationship with bad news. items.body: Deathrock has always had a practical relationship with bad news. A macabre sense of mortality supplies the subject matter, punk supplies the impatience, and everyday life keeps renewing the subscription. East Bay four-piece Normal Weirds bring those concerns together on Frown Time, a title that sounds reasonably restrained given the circumstances. Released October 2, the band’s second full-length gathers ten songs that push further into deathpunk and deathrock while retaining their anarcho-punk roots and post-punk unease. The band’s own description, “deathrock gloom dragged through the dirt of punk,” gives a useful indication of the record’s priorities: atmosphere, abrasion, and the urgency of having something unpleasant to get off your chest. Normal Weirds released their debut album, Same Difference, in 2024, followed by the six-song EP No Lease On Life in 2025. The debut examined growing up and working free of the circumstances that had already laid out a person’s future. Taken alongside that earlier record, Frown Time suggests a widening field of concern, with individual frustration meeting the larger sense that the whole arrangement is becoming increasingly fucked. Driving basslines and hard, direct drums provide the foundation, with guitars moving between wiry punk attack and darker passages thickened by effects. Urgent, sometimes theatrical vocals heighten the unease, while lean arrangements preserve the roughness of the band’s approach. The emphasis stays on noise, tension, and the force of the playing, giving their darker direction a distinctly physical edge. The band offers Rudimentary Peni, Cemetery, T.S.O.L., and Chain Cult as points of comparison. “Deathpunk” feels like a useful shorthand for the territory they describe, where punk aggression and deathrock atmosphere share the same cramped quarters. Across their releases, Normal Weirds have increasingly brought those impulses together, giving the darker material a harder and more direct frame. Mortality, alienation, and everyday absurdity run through the album’s lyrical concerns. Its ominous mood draws on both personal experience and a broader disillusionment with the present. There is a bluntness to the title that suits that outlook: Frown Time makes room for the irritation and apprehension people are often expected to swallow while getting on with their day. Frown Time was recorded, mixed, and produced by Skot Brown of Altar De Fey and mastered by Greg Wilkinson. The album is available to stream and purchase on Bandcamp here. It will be released on other streaming platforms, excluding Spotify, on October 16, 2026. items._cn_summary: Normal Weirds 的第二张全长专辑延续了死亡摇滚与朋克的混合路线，将阴郁氛围与粗糙力道一并推至前台。十首曲目在死亡摇滚的阴冷基调上嵌入无政府朋克的急迫感和后朋克的不安，吉他线条时而尖锐时而厚重，配合紧迫且略带戏剧感的人声，制造出明显的物理压迫感。贝斯线条驱动而直接，鼓击生猛干脆，整体制作刻意保留原始躁感。歌词层面，死亡、疏离与日常荒诞交织，既来自个人经验，也折射出对当下现实的不满与失望。专辑标题本身直白地呼应这种情绪。录音由 Altar De Fey 的 Skot Brown 完成，母带由 Greg Wilkinson 处理，整体保持了地下乐队应有的粗粝质地。

items.body: Review by Fercandio46 — Pekka Streng's music is colored by his personal history, much like the stories of Tim Buckley or Nick Drake, singer-songwriters who passed away prematurely. Perhaps unconsciously, they gravitated toward that deeply intimate, heart-wrenching subgenre, the folk singer-songwriter, in which an artist reveals so much of themselves. He was accompanied by musicians from the Finnish jazz scene, such as Eero Koivistoinen and Pekka P�yry (on saxophone and flute, respectively); both would later participate in bassist Pekka Pohjola's album Harakka Bialoipokku (1974)."Mimosaneito" ventures into jazz, yet the mood shifts to something more intimate and reflective on "Kaukana." Pekka possessed the power to transport us out of our reality through the sheer magic of his vocal timbre; like singer-songwriters such as Donovan, he commanded a rich stylistic range, shifting between psychedelic, acoustic, jazz-inflected, and ethereal sounds, to enter that mythological realm which, at times during the 60s and 70s, felt so real it was almost tangible.From the groove-laden pop of the track ...Ja Tuittu Ruusut Sai to a blues piece with a touch of rustic country in Perhonen. However, it was Pekka's more mystical, mysterious, and inspired side that truly shone when he sang in Finnish, performing tracks like Auringon Lapsi that evoked distant, almost medieval, times, as if they had reached us through oral tradition. It was also reminiscent of the early days of Tyrannosaurus Rex, when Marc Bolan favored an acoustic sound and explored Eastern and psychedelic influences.As for the title, it alludes to the land in summer, when everything bursts into color and blooms; the summer solstice is precisely when Juhannus is celebrated in Finland, a time when people traditionally headed to the lakes throughout June. Both the cover art and the music convey something of this spirit. It ranges from a dark organ solo on "Kanttorinpoika Max" to the magical "Katsele Y�ss�," featuring only Pekka's voice, his guitar, and a rather Baroque-style sopranino saxophone solo.Roope Hattu reminded me of the freshness and freedom of Bob Dylan's bluesy "The Man in Me", though this was the Finnish version, transformed by Jukka Ruohom�ki's synthesizers into a kind of cosmic blues, evolving from the style of The Band (Dylan's friends and collaborators) into something otherworldly. "Puutarhassa" sports a very welcome bossa nova vibe that lends itself well to the acoustic format and the album's stylistic, and emotional, variety, shifting from the optimism of a sunny day... to the introspection of a gray, rainy one, if we are talking about stereotypes, that is. Though certainly not musical ones."Mutta Min� L�hden" is curiously divided into two parts: one acoustic, featuring guitar, and another with vocals and the celesta, that instrument created by the French harmonium maker Auguste Mustel. Resembling a glockenspiel, it takes us by surprise not only with its sweetness but also with its brevity; it is a piece filled with ambivalence, yet one that leaves us certain we have heard a genuine expression of the artist's own voice.
items._cn_summary: 这张芬兰1972年的民谣唱片由词曲创作者Pekka Streng主导，邀请芬兰爵士乐手参与录音，将民谣、爵士、迷幻与中世纪元素熔于一炉。乐评将Streng的创作与Tim Buckley、Nick Drake、Donovan及早期Tyrannosaurus Rex相比，着重描述他以芬兰语演唱时呈现的神秘色彩，歌曲涉及爵士探索、bossa nova节奏、巴洛克风格高音直管萨克斯独奏、合成器营造的宇宙蓝调，以及钢片琴与吉他并置的声部对比。专辑名指向仲夏时节芬兰湖区的传统庆典，封面与音乐共同传达季节感。整体属于民谣与爵士的跨界融合，但文章未深入讨论先锋实验手法或电子音色设计，对偏好实验/前卫音乐和电子音乐的听众而言创新性有限。

items.body: Review by Warthur — This is Jack Bruce's firet solo album, at least in terms of release date - the Things We Like jamsession was recorded prior to this and released as a follow-up. I've never fully gotten onboard withCream, and maybe it's Eric Clapton that's the component that doesn't quite land for me, becausebetween Ginger Baker's work elsewhere and now this I can say I'm more impressed with the other Creammembers' solo fare than Clapton's.What you get here is bluesy art rock with brilliant bass lines and poetic lyrics by Pete Brown. Somesongs on here ended up travelling widely, with Mountain, Colosseum, and Greenslade covering farelike Theme From An Imaginary Western or Rope Ladder To the Moon; others definitely qualify as deepcuts. Either way, well worth exploring.

items.body: Harry Birch wrote “Don’t Give Up” while he was drinking himself under and his mother was dying of bone cancer. “This song saved me,” he says. He wrote it for her. The music pulls against all that: warm bass, guitar ringing bright over it, the tempo unhurried. Only the first line gives it away, Birch calling himself “a whiskey walking junkie”. Halfway through the song, he hands a verse to Lunda, a French-Congolese singer working in soul and indie rock. The chorus asks for time to put a broken life back together: “Please don’t give up on me / ‘Cause oh on our love we can revive / the pieces of our life…” Birch is Kaya Street, the Bristol project he writes, sings and produces. He formed it in 2014 as a ten-piece soul band, broke it up in early 2024 to get into the studio properly, then rebuilt it at the end of that year around live horns, drums and electronics. Juno-winning Toronto producer Dubmatix is producing the next Kaya Street album. “Don’t Give Up” stands apart from the afrobeat he usually works in, and from the political songs that come with it. Stream “Don’t Give Up” HERE The post Daily Discovery: Kaya Street – Don’t Give Up appeared first on Rhythm Passport.
items._cn_summary: Harry Birch以Kaya Street之名创作了这首歌，创作背景极具个人情感重量——母亲因骨癌去世期间，他借酒消愁时写下了这首作品。音乐层面却与沉重主题形成对比：温暖的低音、吉他明亮地在上方延展、节奏从容不迫，仅在开篇以"威士忌游荡的瘾君子"一句泄露创作者的真实状态。歌曲中段邀请法属刚果裔歌手Lunda加入一段演唱，合唱部分请求时间以重建破碎的生活。Kaya Street最初是Birch于2014年成立的十人灵魂乐队，2024年初解散以便专注录音，年末重组后融入电子制作与现场管乐。该曲与其通常的非洲节拍和政治题材作品形成区别，多伦多制作人Dubmatix将负责下一张专辑的制作。

items.body: Pygmy Children reissue their 1994 debut album “Malignant” as “Malignant: Redux” via Re:Mission Entertainment. The label describes the release as electro-industrial and EBM, with a release date of October 2, 2026. The original “Malignant” was recorded by Brian Roper and Pete Roper at Hit And Run Studios in Rockville, Maryland, between September and December 1993, and released on CD via Noname/Noslogan Productions in 1994 with an 11-track listing running from “Shock V3.1” through “File Regarding…”. “Malignant: Redux” adds five further tracks to that original running order. Re:Mission Entertainment has not published a description of what the “Redux” edition changes beyond its expanded tracklist; that detail is not yet confirmed. Malignant : Redux by Pygmy Children About Pygmy Children Pygmy Children is a US electro-industrial project built around Brian Roper and Pete Roper, active since the early 1990s. The duo released their debut album “Malignant” in 1994, followed by “Low Life Dream” in 1998. After a long gap, Pygmy Children returned through Re:Mission Entertainment with the EP “I Have No Name”, the single “Proof in Lies”, the “Signal Unknown” EP and the album “Coincidental Strategies”. “Malignant: Redux”, out October 2, 2026, revisits the project’s debut album more than three decades after its original release.
items._cn_summary: Pygmy Children 是来自美国的电子工业双人组合，由Brian Roper和Pete Roper于1990年代初创立。他们将1994年的首张专辑《Malignant》以《Malignant: Redux》的形式重新发行，由独立厂牌Re:Mission Entertainment发行，新增五首曲目。原始专辑于1993年在马里兰州Rockville的Hit And Run Studios录制，共11首曲目，从《Shock V3.1》到《File Regarding…》。文章为新闻性质的信息发布，详细介绍了发行背景、厂牌信息和乐队历史，但缺少对音乐本身的声音设计、编曲特点或艺术价值的深入评析。这张重新发行版为该项目的早期作品提供了回顾机会，让听众得以重新认识这个沉寂多年的电子工业项目的起点。

items.body: Tangent Strategy announces “Tristesse”, the project’s first new full-length album in five years. The album is inspired by the music of John Foxx and Die Form. “Tristesse” explores the fragile human psyche, where anger and melancholy sit next to each other. It looks at the defiance inside relationships, healthy and unhealthy alike, and the marks they leave on the people in them. Production-wise, the album takes a simpler approach than before, keeping the songs raw with deep bass, stark arrangements and noise running through the mix. “In an age of detachment, Tristesse is a reminder that attachment is no certain comfort either,” the project states. Tristesse by Tangent Strategy About Tangent Strategy Tangent Strategy was formed in 1996 by chd.y as an outlet for a musical outlook that grew more and more drawn to industrial music over the years. The project’s first full-length, “Revenant”, came out in November 2021 via EK Product. Since then, chd.y has released several EPs under the name and performed live in Tokyo. “Tristesse”, announced in 2026, is Tangent Strategy’s second full-length album.
items._cn_summary: Tangent Strategy 即将发布第二张全长专辑《Tristesse》，距离首张专辑《Revenant》已有五年。灵感来源于 John Foxx 与 Die Form 的音乐，专辑聚焦于脆弱的人类心理，探讨愤怒与忧郁并存的情感状态，以及关系中健康与非健康的反抗主题。制作上采用更简洁的手法，以深沉的低音、极简的编曲和贯穿混音的噪音元素，保持原始粗粝的质感。项目自1996年由 chd.y 创立，长期活跃于东京地下工业场景，新作由 EK Product 厂牌发行，延续了冷峻的工业暗潮路线。

items.body: Vampire Valentine release “Scarred & Sacred” on October 25, 2026 via Morella Records. The six-track EP is the UK darkwave and post-punk trio’s fourth release since signing to the label on January 15, 2026, following a run of singles, the “Pale Dawn” EP and their self-titled debut album this past August. Where the self-titled album was a complete statement of the band’s sound, “Scarred & Sacred” follows a single arc across its six tracks: sin, repentance and the reckoning that waits at the gate. “Scarred & Sacred is our sins repenting and facing your fate in the afterlife at the gate,” the band says. “We wanted six tracks that felt like one story, not six songs that happened to ship together. It starts calm and it does not stay that way.” Scarred & Sacred tracklist Scarred (instrumental) – an atmospheric, melodic intro that turns unsettling, setting up the EP. Broken Sins – a full-length track pairing darkwave production with post-punk revival. Talisman – the story of a lover placing a talisman with a dying partner to guide them to the other side. Lover Not A Biter (instrumental) – a hard-driven darksynth track. GORE! (instrumental) – a darksynth cut the band describes as built on 1980s horror soundtracks and visuals. Sacred – the title track and closer, a post-punk song ending on vocals from frontman Michael Longstaff. Credits Michael Longstaff handles lyrics and vocals, Kieron Wright plays bass and Tobias Cowen Pickard plays drums. Tony Gunk produced, composed, mixed and mastered all six tracks. Ricky Conover, who records as Forerunnerx, co-produced and co-composed “Scarred”, “Lover Not A Biter” and “GORE!”. Blake Carpenter plays guitar on “Broken Sins”, “Talisman”, “Lover Not A Biter” and “GORE!”. About Vampire Valentine Vampire Valentine is a darkwave and post-punk band from Newcastle upon Tyne, formed in October 2025 by producer Michael Longstaff and bassist/guitarist Kieron Wright, who connected through a mutual acquaintance, along with drummer Tobias Cowen Pickard. US producers Ricky Conover (Forerunnerx) and Tony Gunk handle production. The band draws on The Sisters of Mercy, Twin Tribes, She Past Away and Lebanon Hanover. They debuted on November 14, 2025 with the single “Porcelain”, backed with “Olivia”, which goth journalist Mick Mercer called an “Excellent Debut”. A second single, “Thorns”, followed on December 1, 2025. Vampire Valentine signed to Morella Records on January 15, 2026 and released their debut full-length album that August, having already shared the singles “In The Dark” and “Cutting Ties” from it. “Scarred & Sacred”, out October 25, follows as the band’s fourth Morella release in under a year.
items._cn_summary: Vampire Valentine 是来自英国纽卡斯尔的暗潮与后朋克三人组合，于2026年10月通过独立厂牌 Morella Records 发行六曲EP《Scarred & Sacred》。作品以「罪、忏悔与彼岸审判」为核心叙事线，六首曲目被设计为一个连贯的整体，从开篇器乐引入的沉静氛围逐步推向更激烈的不安感。制作人Tony Gunk与Forerunnerx联合操刀，编曲中融合了darkwave合成器质感、后朋克复兴元素以及受1980年代恐怖电影配乐启发的darksynth段落。乐队主唱Michael Longstaff同时负责歌词撰写，贝斯手Kieron Wright与鼓手Tobias Cowen Pickard构成稳定节奏基底，吉他手Blake Carpenter参与多首曲目录制。整体上，作品延续了The Sisters of Mercy、Twin Tribes等经典暗潮乐队的影响，在风格融合与氛围塑造上展现了一定的连贯意图，但声音设计与结构选择仍偏向类型化框架内，实验性突破有限。

The track pushes vocalist and multi-instrumentalist Áron Siegler’s electronic side further forward, bringing futurepop and synthwave into the project’s established synthpop sound, with Siegler citing VNV Nation and Chvrches among t
items.body: The Pixel Rain released “Glitching Sky” on October 2, 2026, the fourth and final advance single from the Southeast London act’s debut album, “A Sense of Danger,” due October 29 on Bandcamp, Spotify and other digital platforms. The track pushes vocalist and multi-instrumentalist Áron Siegler’s electronic side further forward, bringing futurepop and synthwave into the project’s established synthpop sound, with Siegler citing VNV Nation and Chvrches among the single’s reference points. At the center of the song is a character retreating from an unfulfilling reality into a virtual world where he can construct a more powerful version of himself. Siegler extends the idea beyond any specific technology or platform to a broader comment on how people seek distraction from anxiety, disappointment and everyday life. Siegler describes the retreat as carrying both sadness and absurdity: “The idea came from thinking about someone whose real life isn’t giving them very much, so they retreat into a virtual world where they can be whoever they want to be. There’s something quite sad about that, but also something a little ridiculous, so I wanted the story to have both sides to it. “I deliberately left the virtual world undefined because I think that kind of escape can take a lot of different forms. I’m certainly not outside of it myself. We all have things we disappear into when reality gets uncomfortable. “The music is quite fast and energetic, but the song itself takes its time building. That seemed to fit the idea: you don’t necessarily notice yourself getting drawn further and further into these little distractions until they’ve started taking up much more of your life than you intended.” The single arrives with a visualizer by Sophie Maria Vickers, built around the song’s virtual setting and digital imagery. Glitching Sky by The Pixel Rain On Bandcamp, “Glitching Sky” is bundled together with The Pixel Rain’s three earlier advance singles, “Last,” “A Sense of Danger” and “Sacrifice.” The single is also on Spotify and other major platforms. About The Pixel Rain The Pixel Rain is the solo project of vocalist and multi-instrumentalist Áron Siegler, originally from Hungary and now based in Southeast London. The project emerged from London’s underground scene with a self-titled debut EP in 2023, and mixes dark electronic and post-punk elements with guitar, electronics and industrial textures. The Pixel Rain released the first single from its forthcoming debut album, “Last,” on June 19, 2026, with a video shot in Hungary in which Siegler was joined on screen by Balázs Fűr, András Melles, Máté Breier and Máté Király-Gyeőry. The singles “A Sense of Danger” and “Sacrifice” followed over the summer, each previewing the album further. “Glitching Sky,” released October 2, 2026, is the fourth and final advance single before the debut album “A Sense of Danger” arrives on October 29, 2026. The album explores power, authority, consumerism and social unease through recurring post-apocalyptic and technological imagery.
items._cn_summary: The Pixel Rain 是来自匈牙利、定居伦敦东南部的独立项目，主创 Áron Siegler 以单人身份主导创作，将 futurepop 与 synthwave 元素注入其原有的 synthpop 框架，参考 VNV Nation 与 Chvrches 的方向。单曲《Glitching Sky》构建了一个角色逃离现实、遁入虚拟世界的叙事，Siegler 并未将虚拟空间指向任何特定技术，而是将其泛化为现代人逃避焦虑与失望的普遍方式——歌曲兼具悲哀与荒诞的双重色彩。编曲快速而充满能量，但结构铺陈循序渐进，暗喻人逐渐被微小消遣吞噬而不自知的过程。视觉部分由 Sophie Maria Vickers 制作，呼应数字影像主题。项目融合吉他、电子与工业质感，扎根于伦敦地下场景，整体在暗潮与合成器流行之间寻找交叉地带。

The track is the Bern-based darkwave, synthpop and coldwave act’s first release on the Danish label. “Last Night On Earth” follows a narrator watching Earth’s final hours from roughly seven hundred miles above the planet, aboard a spacecraft where the oxygen cycles mechanically and the view of the dying world shrinks to a reflec
items.body: Town And Towers Records has signed Swiss duo CØLDSTAR, releasing the band’s new single “Last Night On Earth” on 2 October 2026. The track is the Bern-based darkwave, synthpop and coldwave act’s first release on the Danish label. “Last Night On Earth” follows a narrator watching Earth’s final hours from roughly seven hundred miles above the planet, aboard a spacecraft where the oxygen cycles mechanically and the view of the dying world shrinks to a reflection in glass. The lyrics state the moment directly: “The blue marble fades in a rear view of glass / I watch from the silence as centuries pass.” There is no rescue attempt in the story and no final message, only “a velvet curtain, and we’re not coming back.” Dark synth layers, pulsing electronic rhythms and melancholic melodies carry the track’s icy, futuristic atmosphere. Town And Towers names VNV Nation and Black Nail Cabaret as reference points for that sound. Recommend to fans of Solar Fake, Final Selection, Depeche Mode, Covenant and The Soft Moon. CØLDSTAR’s ‘Last Night On Earth’ is the duo’s first release for Town And Towers Records “Last Night On Earth” is out now as a digital single, also streaming via Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, Amazon Music, YouTube Music, SoundCloud and Tidal. Last Night On Earth by CØLDSTAR Town And Towers Records’ recent roster also includes deZeption, signed in 2024, and Hatif, whose album “Small States” arrived via the label in 2025. About CØLDSTAR Martin Baumann and Michael Freund record as CØLDSTAR from Bern, Switzerland, mixing darkwave, synthpop, coldwave and retro-futurist synth sounds. The duo’s songs use space and science-fiction imagery to address isolation, memory, technology, longing and human existence. CØLDSTAR’s early releases included a 2021 cover of Nine Inch Nails‘ “Hurt.” The band built out its own catalogue with the “Coming Home” EP in 2023, then the debut album “CØSMIC DUST” in 2024 via Swiss Dark Nights, combining atmospheric electronics, synthpop melody and darker post-punk influences. Singles “Time Machine,” “Astronaut’s Lament,” “Last Dance” and “Post-Punk Robot” followed. “Post-Punk Robot” reached number 2 on the Deutsche Alternative Charts in 2026. “Last Night On Earth” is the fifth single CØLDSTAR has issued since “CØSMIC DUST,” and the first through Town And Towers Records.
items._cn_summary: 瑞士双人组CØLDSTAR签约丹麦厂牌Town And Towers Records后发布单曲《Last Night On Earth》。歌曲以太空叙事为框架，讲述一位叙述者从距地球约七百英里的飞船上目睹蓝色星球在玻璃后视镜中逐渐消逝的过程，歌词直接呈现'蓝色弹珠在玻璃后视中褪色，我于沉默中观看着世纪流逝'的画面。全无救援企图或最终遗言，只余'天鹅绒帷幕落下，我们不再归来'的冷峻收束。暗黑合成器层次、脉冲式电子节拍与忧郁旋律构筑出冰冷而未来主义的氛围。乐队此前曾以2024年专辑《CØLMIC DUST》于瑞士暗黑厂牌Swiss Dark Nights出道，单曲《Post-Punk Robot》曾登上德国另类榜第二名。这篇文章为Side-Line的厂牌新闻稿，侧重签约及发行信息传递，对音乐本身的深度评论有限。

items.body: Danish/UK electronic duo Oui Plastique release the single “For The Cry Of Anguish” on October 16, 2026 through Town and Towers Records. It is the fourth and final single from the project’s second album, “Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It”, due November 27, 2026 on the same Danish label. A Bandcamp page for the single had not gone live at the time of writing. Oui Plastique close the singles campaign for ‘Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It’ “For The Cry Of Anguish” follows three earlier singles from the same album: “Revival” in April 2026, “Linger” on June 12, 2026, and “Spirit” on September 4, 2026. “Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It” is Oui Plastique’s second album, following the 2022 debut “Fraternity of Strangers”. It runs 14 tracks and releases digitally, on CD and on vinyl through Town and Towers Records on November 27, 2026. Oui Plastique set up the song’s premise directly: “For The Cry Of Anguish is a song about seeing something you were never meant to see – and discovering that some things, once witnessed, can never be unseen.“ Oui Plastique previously posted a teaser video for “Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It” to the duo’s YouTube channel, titled “Oui Plastique – ‘Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It’ – Album Teaser”. About Oui Plastique Oui Plastique is the duo of Martin Nyrup (Denmark) and James Thomas (UK). The project grew out of a 2017 collaboration between Nyrup, also one half of the dark wave duo Perpacity, and Thomas, of the band DVL, who together recorded the album “Convergence” that year. In 2018 the pair recorded a three-track covers EP for the UnMute project, a tribute to Mute Records, released on Bandcamp as “UM EP 04” on February 1, 2019. Before the debut album, four of its eventual tracks appeared as standalone digital singles: “Failure” on March 8, 2021, “The Fear” on May 28, 2021, “Crossing Over” on September 24, 2021, and “Wish Yourself Away” on November 26, 2021. The 11-track debut album “Fraternity of Strangers” followed on January 28, 2022, on CD through ScentAir Records. A remastered edition of “Convergence” followed in 2022. In August 2025, the UnMute covers were remastered and reissued across platforms as the EP “UnMute”, featuring the Martin Gore-associated tracks “Compulsion”, “The Bottom Line” and “It Doesn’t Matter Two”, through Town and Towers Records. Nyrup’s other project, Perpacity, released the album “Discordia” in 2023 and the Danish-language single “Lille Flamme” in May 2025. “Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It” arrives on November 27, 2026. It is Oui Plastique’s first full-length through Town and Towers Records, following the 2022 debut on ScentAir Records.
items._cn_summary: Oui Plastique是由丹麦音乐人Martin Nyrup与英国音乐人James Thomas组成的电子二人组，他们即将在独立厂牌Town and Towers Records发行第二张专辑《Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It》。《For The Cry Of Anguish》是这张14轨专辑释出的第四支也是最后一支先行单曲，延续了此前《Revival》《Linger》《Spirit》的发行节奏。Nyrup同时也是暗潮二人组Perpacity的成员，该项目于2023年发行了专辑《Discordia》，为Oui Plastique带来深厚的暗潮底蕴。乐队也以翻唱Martin Gore关联曲目组成的《UnMute》EP展现出对电子传统的敬意。新专辑主题定调为关于目击不该目睹之物、且无法再将其忘却的体验，延续了乐队自2017年合作以来对阴郁氛围电子声响的探索。

items.body: Death Strip release their fourth single, “Flash Back,” on October 8, 2026. The duo mixes darkwave and EBM with an electro-punk edge. “Flash Back” runs at 136 BPM, built on distorted saw bass, strobing arpeggios and deadpan spoken word. Recommend to fans of Boy Harsher, Gesaffelstein and The Prodigy. The single is scheduled to land on Death Strip’s Bandcamp and Spotify pages on release day. About Death Strip Death Strip pairs Jonas Moberg, a Swedish producer and drummer based on Gotland, with vocalist Culture Yob, also known as Son of Daughter, based in Hastings, England. Moberg played drums in the Swedish rock band Jumper, which released three albums and eleven singles between 1996 and 2000, and later played live drums for Paloma Faith early in her career. Culture Yob co-founded the band Gobsausage with Takalina and Miss Halski in the early 2000s, and also co-founded Charles of London, according to the band. The two met in the 2000s and lived in neighboring warehouse flats in Shoreditch, London, where they shared a goods lift. They now live apart, Moberg on Gotland and Culture Yob in Hastings, and write and record Death Strip’s music remotely. The two have never been in the same room for a Death Strip session. “Flash Back,” released October 8, 2026, is the fourth single Death Strip has made this way.
items._cn_summary: Death Strip由瑞典制作人Jonas Moberg与英国歌手Culture Yob远程合作组成，二人从未在录音中同处一室。2026年10月8日发行的第四支单曲《Flash Back》以136 BPM的速度展开，核心音色由失真锯齿波贝斯、频闪式琶音序列与平淡的念白人声构成，混合暗潮与EBM骨架并注入电子朋克的棱角。推荐的参照对象包括Boy Harsher、Gesaffelstein与The Prodigy，暗示其在冷感机械节奏与暗黑律动之间的定位。远程协作模式本身具有一定实验性，但文章整体为新闻稿性质，缺乏对声音美学与创作意图的深入评述，信息深度有限。

items.album: My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult’s ‘The Reincarnation of Luna’ turns 25 on 2 October
items.excerpt: Chicago industrial dance band My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult released “The Reincarnation of Luna” on 2 October 2001 through SleazeBox Records, the band’s own label, distributed by Invisible Records. The album turns 25 this year. My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult recorded and mixed the album at Starlust Studios in Los Angeles, with Buzz McCoy producing. Groovie Mann and Buzz McCoy wrote all twelve tracks, performed with the Bomb Gang Girlz, and Chris Greene handled mastering.
items.body: Chicago industrial dance band My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult released “The Reincarnation of Luna” on 2 October 2001 through SleazeBox Records, the band’s own label, distributed by Invisible Records. The album turns 25 this year. My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult recorded and mixed the album at Starlust Studios in Los Angeles, with Buzz McCoy producing. Groovie Mann and Buzz McCoy wrote all twelve tracks, performed with the Bomb Gang Girlz, and Chris Greene handled mastering. The tracklist runs: “Radio Silicon” “The Untouchable Class” “Hour of Zero” “The Kult Konnection” “Girl Without a Planet” “Temptation Serenade” “Bettie” “Flesh Playhouse” “Heelz Afire” “Jungle of Love” “Asylum Disciple” “Theme De Luna” “The Reincarnation of Luna” was My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult’s first release on their own SleazeBox Records imprint, following “A Crime for All Seasons” (1997) on Red Ant Records. The band released a companion remix set, “Golden Pillz: The Luna Remixes,” and a live album, “Elektrik Inferno,” in the same period. In 2007, the band re-recorded and remixed the album for Rykodisc under the title “The Resurrection of Luna,” adding “Ocean of Hate,” “Hallowed Be My Name” and a remix of “Temptation Serenade.” The original 2001 version remains available through the band’s own site. About My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult, often shortened to Thrill Kill Kult or TKK, formed in Chicago in 1987. Groovie Mann (born Frankie Nardiello) and Buzz McCoy (born Marston Daley) met that year while touring with Ministry and began recording music for an unfinished art film of the same name. Wax Trax! Records released the completed songs as a three-track EP, and when it sold well, the full-length “I See Good Spirits and I See Bad Spirits” followed in 1988. “Confessions of a Knife…” (1990) became one of Wax Trax!’s best-selling releases, and “Sexplosion!” (1991) pushed the band toward a more psychedelic house and disco sound while drawing attention from Interscope Records, which signed the band and released the alternative-radio single “Sex on Wheelz.” “13 Above the Night” (1993) and “Hit & Run Holiday” (1995) followed on Interscope before the band parted ways with the label in 1996. “A Crime for All Seasons” (1997) came out on Red Ant Records, and “The Reincarnation of Luna” (2001) marked the start of the band’s own SleazeBox Records imprint, distributed by Invisible Records. Rykodisc later became the band’s home, reissuing its back catalog alongside the rarities set “Dirty Little Secrets,” the mash-up album “Diamonds & Daggerz” (2004) and the long-shelved “Gay, Black and Married” (2005). SleazeBox partnered with Italy’s Rustblade label in 2009, issuing “Blood + Dope + Sin + Gold” (2008), “Death Threat” (2009) and “Sinister Whisperz” (2011), and Side-Line covered the band’s 2020 “Sinister Whisperz” retrospective installment, “The Rykodisc Years.” Buzz McCoy has also remixed tracks for KMFDM, Pigface and other acts, and recorded as Excessive Force with KMFDM’s Sascha Konietzko. The band has contributed songs to film soundtracks including “Cool World” (1992), “The Crow” (1994), in which members also appeared performing in a nightclub scene, “The Flintstones” (1994), “Showgirls” (1995) and “Baseketball” (1998). My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult toured the US in spring 2026 with support from Heavy Halo, as Side-Line reported at the time, continuing to perform a catalog that this October marks the 25th anniversary of “The Reincarnation of Luna.”
items._cn_summary: 本文并非传统意义上的乐评，而是一篇以专辑25周年纪念为契机的资讯性回顾，梳理了My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult乐队2001年专辑《The Reincarnation of Luna》的发行背景、制作团队与完整曲目列表，并简述了乐队自1987年成立以来的厂牌变迁与风格演进轨迹。该乐队源自芝加哥工业音乐场景，融合了电子舞曲、迷幻浩室与迪斯科元素，横跨工业与暗潮两大领域。文章还提及该专辑随后衍生出混音合集、现场专辑，以及2007年由Rykodisc重新录制再版的经过。原文对专辑本身的音乐特征、制作手法及艺术价值缺乏深入分析，更接近档案式信息整理而非评论性文字，因此作为乐评参考价值有限。

items.body: Belgian electronic artist Franky Deblomme releases a new EP as Cubic, “Elements,” on October 2, 2026 via Alfa Matrix. The five-track digital release moves the project’s minimal electro sound into more dynamic techno territory. Elements EP by CUBIC ‘Elements’ draws on 80s electro, 90s techno and dub techno “Elements” draws on 1980s electro, 1990s techno in the style of R&S Records, and acid and dub techno, the reference points that have run through Cubic’s sound over the years, with Alfa Matrix noting a nod toward contemporary acts such as Bicep and Modeselektor. Opening track “Future Past” and the two versions of “BangBang,” a Detroit edit and a Chicago edit, push the EP toward a more dancefloor-oriented, energetic direction. “A Fish” and “Chord Memory” keep the minimal sequences, vintage electronics and repeating patterns that recur through Cubic’s releases. ‘Elements’ EP tracklist “Future Past” (4:31) “BangBang” (Detroit edit) (4:26) “A Fish” (4:35) “Chord Memory” (4:55) “BangBang” (Chicago edit) (4:10) The EP is a digital release, available as a download via the Alfa Matrix Bandcamp page, with streaming included, at up to 24-bit/44.1kHz. About Cubic Cubic is the electronic project of Belgian artist Franky Deblomme, also known for his earlier work as 808 Dot Pop. Deblomme signed Cubic to Alfa Matrix and released the project’s label debut EP, “Alphabet Hymn,” on March 9, 2021. The five-track EP combined vintage Dusseldorf synth influences, Berlin techno, 1990s Manchester rave and EBM, built entirely on hardware synthesizers and effects at Deblomme’s Bong 13 studio, and included a remix by label mates 808 Dot Pop. Later that month, Cubic reworked an earlier 808 Dot Pop album into “The Cubic Temperature,” released March 26, 2021 with an exclusive Bandcamp megamix bonus track. Cubic’s debut album, “The Cubic Alphabet,” arrived on June 18, 2021. The project continued with the EP “Phonic Lessons Part 3” on December 7, 2021, then the singles “Exit – Frankfurt” on April 7, 2022 and the four-track “Exit – Ghent” on June 29, 2022, each tied to a specific city’s electronic scene. The EPs “c64” (September 18, 2023) and “c128” (December 6, 2023), both referencing Commodore home computers, preceded the album “Back To Basic,” released on Alfa Matrix on June 4, 2024 with a Kraftwerk-indebted sound made using the first Belgian-made drum computer (Modor DR2) and synthesizer (Modor NF1). Cubic released the vinyl EP “EFM01 (Black)” in an ultra-limited run in June 2025, then the digital EP “EFM02” in October 2025 and the rework album “Back To 808” in December 2025. The twin EPs “CB-708” and “CB-128,” revisiting “Back To 808,” came out in February 2026. “Elements,” out October 2, 2026, is Cubic’s newest EP on Alfa Matrix. The eight-track release previews the band’s fifteenth studio album, “The Kinematics Of Doubt,” due October 30 on the same label. I’m Only Happy When You Bleed EP by IMPLANT ‘I’m Only Happy When You Bleed’ is the second single from ‘The Kinematics Of Doubt’ The title track is the second song revealed from “The Kin
items.body: Belgian EBM act Implant releases the EP “I’m Only Happy When You Bleed” on October 2, 2026 via Alfa Matrix. The eight-track release previews the band’s fifteenth studio album, “The Kinematics Of Doubt,” due October 30 on the same label. I’m Only Happy When You Bleed EP by IMPLANT ‘I’m Only Happy When You Bleed’ is the second single from ‘The Kinematics Of Doubt’ The title track is the second song revealed from “The Kinematics Of Doubt,” after lead single “Underneath The Neon Lights.” Built on a 3/4 rhythm, it pairs evolving electronic layers and a shifting pulse with lyrics centered on control, cruelty and forced submission. The EP extends the single into an eight-track release. “Information Systems” opens the record with a long-form soundscape built entirely from spoken samples about the mythology of computing. “The Insider” addresses privileged knowledge and how much of what people take as fact is actually interpretation or assumption. “Pills (in f sharp)” reworks the album track “Pills” into a different key, turning its “I want more pills” refrain into both a chant and a comment on the pursuit of quick fixes. “Underneath The Neon Lights” also appears on the EP. Three remixes of the title track close the release. New York act Crash Course In Science turns the song into a club-oriented dance track. People Theatre take it in a more melodic direction before a detuned lead takes over. Belgian label mate Aiboforcen contributes a version Alfa Matrix describes as distinctly Aiboforcen’s own while staying rooted in Implant’s sound. ‘I’m Only Happy When You Bleed’ EP tracklist “Information Systems” (3:16) “I’m Only Happy When You Bleed” (4:00) “Underneath The Neon Lights” (4:55) “I’m Only Happy When You Bleed” (Crash Course In Science remix) (4:39) “Pills (in f sharp)” (4:00) “I’m Only Happy When You Bleed” (People Theatre vein remix) (5:32) “The Insider” (4:33) “I’m Only Happy When You Bleed” (Aiboforcen remix) (4:12) The EP is a digital release, available as a download in MP3 and FLAC via the Alfa Matrix Bandcamp page, with streaming included, at up to 16-bit/44.1kHz. ‘The Kinematics Of Doubt’ follows on October 30 Side-Line previously reported on “The Kinematics Of Doubt” in Implant sets 15th album ‘The Kinematics Of Doubt’ for 30 October on Alfa Matrix. The fourteen-track album is issued on CD and digital and includes “I’m Only Happy When You Bleed” alongside “The Observer Effect,” “Underneath The Neon Lights,” “Pills,” “Civilization,” “Sanity,” “Framed,” “Transaction Failure,” “Are You Crying?,” “Talking In Your Sleep,” “Beyond The Code,” “No Apologies Required,” “On TV” and “Wounds.” Implant and Llumen launch their respective albums together on November 20, 2026 at mOtown in Sint-Joost-ten-Node, Belgium. About Implant Implant is the electro-industrial project Len Lemeire started in Belgium in 1996. The debut CD single, “Fun,” credited to Lemeire alongside Geert Machtelinck, was pressed in a numbered edition of 1,000 copies that year. The project’s catalogue spans harsh EBM, industrial dance, electro-pop and dark synth across releases including “Implantology,” “Audio Blender,” “The Productive Citizen” and the EP “Fading Away,” closing most releases with the line “Did you have your Implant today?” Implant released the free download single “The Drive” in December 2023. The twelfth studio album, “The Chaos Machines Part 1 – No More Flies On The Windscreen,” followed in May 2024. Lemeire discussed its modular-synth approach and a duet with Noemi Aurora in Implant interview: ‘Embrace chaos through the machines!’. The trilogy continued with the limited vinyl EP “The Chaos Machines Part 2 – Scratching The Surface” in September 2024 and closed with the album “Judging Sinners – The Chaos Machines Part 3” on February 7, 2025, again featuring Noemi Aurora and covered in Exclusive interview with Implant judging all those sinners. “The Kinematics Of Doubt,” Implant’s fifteenth studio album, follows on October 30, 2026. “I’m Only Happy When You Bleed,” out now as an eight-track EP, is the second single revealed from the record. items.body: Karine Polwart has proved herself to be an exceptional talent as a singer and songwriter for many years, all the way back to her time with Malinky (the song �Thaney� was a revelation). As a solo artist she�s grown and continually expanded her horizons, coming now to Windblown , a project that began life seven years ago, when Polwart, along with sound designer and composer Pippa Murphy, was artist in residence at Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. The album, with its stage show and book, tells the story of the garden�s oldest specimen, a Sabal palm tree ( Sabal bermudana ), which was gently felled in 2021, and contained a surprise nobody had expected. The tree is the starting point. From there, imagination runs free. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan It�s an album of voice and piano (the outstanding, sympathetic Dave Milligan), and, for all its global outlook on connections, one that�s very rooted in Scotland. You can hear it on the opening track, �Hear The Rigging/Last In Line,� where the melody becomes a slow, aching lament that would sound completely natural on the pipes. The stripped-down sound gives the songs both crafted stateliness and real intimacy. Each one is an exhalation, a memory, a celebration and exploration, with recurring phrases in the words and music acting as touchstones � or even hooks; they certainly stick in the mind. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan In many ways, this is a modest album, with piano, voice and light, judicious soundscaping. It won�t overpower with noise. Yet at the same time, it�s epic, a look at history, at the flow and grandeur of nature, and the things we all carry within us. The music, and especially Polwart�s warm, compassionate voice, envelop the listener, and makes them a participant, not an observer, but a part of the journey and the history. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan The irony arrives at the end, when the venerable old tree is down, and seeds are examined. What people for two hundred years had believed to be a Sabal bermudana turns out to be something different, a Sabal mexicana � and one of the small plants fill grow where it�s forerunner once stood. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan Like music, plants keep to a different time � and this album/book/show give the tree the requiem it deserves, as well as hope for the future. Find the artist online. Sara Serpa - Encounters and Collisions (Review) Karine Polwart- Laws of Motion (Review) Live in the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh, 2025

The musical partnership between Kalaniemi and Alakotila has thrived over a remarkable 35 years, long enough to the Finnish pair to develop a stunning intimacy and telepathy. Kalaniemi is a lovingly melodic accordion player, with a sharp ear for a good tune, building each one into a thing of great beauty, while pianist Alakotila not only supports her but adds enough of his own to help transform every piece into a glistening gem.
There�s a sense of calmness to the work here, a long, sweet exhalation between two instrumentalists who are deep enough in sync to allow seamless improvisation beyond any written score and carry the listeners along with them. For much of the album, it�s just the pair of them, including Kalaniemi�s wordless voice, as on the opener, the tradional �Lyck�nskan.� She does charmingly sing lyrics on the title track, written by Lasse M�rtenson, with the sound there neatly and sparingly expanded with the addition of a string quartet.
Morgondimma
There are several original pieces alongside the tradition, with Kalaniemi�s �Hambo Vid F�bodan� a real standout, and it�s perhaps inevitable on any disc featuring accordion that a Piazzolla tune should be included, brings its own shadows to the whole (�Oblivion�). And, this being Finland, a tango is almost obligatory, in this case Alakotila�s �Tango Berlin.�
Tango Berlin
There�s a gentle, dreamlike quality to so much of this, flowing and mellifluous. The pieces aren�t an arena for showy virtuosity. Instead, the two musicians serve the tune, exploring and genuinely enjoying their performances.
It won�t shake the earth, but it makes for some true listening beauty.

items._cn_summary: 这是一张芬兰手风琴与钢琴二重奏专辑，两位音乐家经过三十五年的合作，形成了高度默契的即兴对话。手风琴演奏旋律优美、敏锐地构建动人旋律，钢琴在此基础上提供支撑与个人表达，将每首作品打磨成精致的器乐小品。专辑收录多首原创与传统作品，整体氛围宁静、梦幻、如流水般绵长流畅，弦乐四重奏在标题曲中克制地扩展了音色空间，曲目还包括一首皮亚佐拉探戈与一首芬兰式探戈。两位乐者不追求炫技，而是服务于旋律本身，探索并享受演奏过程。专辑不会震动大地，但提供了真正的聆听之美。

items.body: As the pioneering minimalist composer turns 90, Sean Kitching offers ten points of entry into his back catalogue, and wishes him a Happy Birthday. Portrait by Carolyn Cole A trailblazing contemporary composer with a career spanning over six decades, Steve Reich’s field of influence extends considerably beyond the classical sphere. Considered to be one of the founders of musical minimalism, Reich’s work has been an inspiration to the likes of Philip Glass, John Adams, the ensemble Bang On A Can and Max Richter, as well as to numerous pop and electronic musicians. Talking Heads, The Feelies, Brian Eno, Robert Fripp, Owen Pallett, Jonny Greenwood, Battles, Bryce Dessner of The National, Richie Hawtin (Plastikman), DJ Spooky, Aphex Twin and William Basinski –... The post The Strange World Of… Steve Reich appeared first on The Quietus.
items._cn_summary: 该文章为The Quietus发布的纪念性推介，介绍极简主义作曲家Steve Reich九十岁生日的十张作品入门口。内容以简介作曲家影响力为主，列举了Talking Heads、Brian Eno、Aphex Twin等受其影响的跨界音乐人，呈现了从学院当代古典到电子、摇滚的辐射脉络。然而文章本身偏向导览性质，并未对任何具体专辑的创作手法、声音设计或美学取向展开实质性分析，更接近新闻稿而非深度乐评。极简主义音乐虽具实验血统，但与用户偏好的自由即兴、IDM、暗潮等方向存在一定距离，且跨界影响力多停留于列举层面，缺乏深入的融合性讨论。

items.body: Review by KansasForEver4 — Scotland's most famous band returns in the early fourth quarter of 2026 with its ninth studio album, "A Song for Tomorrow." It is a soundtrack that traverses the Bible, politics, technology, and the (all-too) many conflicts around the globe to explore what lies behind sensationalist media headlines?namely people, their relationships, their emotions, and their experiences."A Song for Tomorrow" presents the dichotomy between our inner selves and the image we project to the world around us: our dreams, the reasons we get up every morning, our falls and recoveries?everything that ultimately defines the human being.PALLAS has chosen a range of themes encompassing environmental collapse, digital surveillance, fracturing relationships, and the unsettling noises of our daily lives. It is a record that showcases the voices of all four band members on equal footing, with each contributing both lead and backing vocals. Did you like the artwork for "The Messenger"? Rest assured, this one is even better; the liner notes reveal nothing about the current hot topic?AI. Mike Bentley is considered the fifth member of PALLAS.The album opens strongly with "Reset" (9/10)?the shortest track on the record, yet one of true beauty that flows effortlessly. It segues into "Rage," a more muscular, almost metallic, and slightly longer track?a piece where Niall Mathewson proves, if proof were needed, that he is a master guitarist (9/10), delivering a sound reminiscent of a wild, Rush-esque soundtrack. "A Song for Tomorrow"?the title track?features the childlike vocals of Natasha O'Neal (who also collaborates with Niall on other musical projects); it is a very calm track until the 4:34 mark, when it intensifies somewhat in the finale, driven by layered backing vocals (9/10). Next up is the epic "The Private Collector," clocking in at over eight minutes; it places Pallas back at the heart of the symphonic progressive rock style the Scottish quartet has mastered since its early days (revisit "The Sentinel" or "The Wedge"?this track is very close to that sound, perhaps leaning more towards the latter). It is a timeless gem?nothing more needs to be said (10/10).The next two tracks, "Dirt" and "Aspirations," are of similar length and tempo; it is hard to say which I prefer. "Dirt" is more accessible and commercial (reminiscent of certain tracks on *The Cross and the Crucible*), whereas "Aspirations" is gentler, featuring quasi-religious backing vocals and Graeme Murray's twelve-string guitar taking center stage (9/10 for the former, 8/10 for the latter). "Rushing Headlong" is far more frenetic?another short piece, and thankfully so, as it was the only track on the album I genuinely disliked; it is chaotic?a term I sometimes use?and messy (6/10).The final three tracks?comprising a third of the album's total runtime?represent the very best of the symphonic progressive rock genre, of which Pallas has long been a leading light. First is "The Avenue of Broken Dreams," featuring a slow rhythmic build-up, Ronnie Brown's atmospheric keyboards, and Niall Matthewson's guitar work?lyrical, inventive, and tastefully restrained. A musical delight (9/10). Then, the shorter, calmer "Mother" (8/10) serves as a breather before what follows: the concluding track, "Inside Outside." This piece distills the very essence of what has defined PALLAS for decades into just over nine minutes. It is a melodic ascent showcasing the musicians at their peak, featuring the kind of soaring lead vocals and magnificent backing harmonies we love, alongside top-tier symphonic elements (10/10).As a side note, the absence of a real drummer didn't bother me in the slightest; Niall and Ronnie split the percussion programming duties depending on the track. It will be interesting to see how this translates to the stage during the band's final tour in a few weeks, as Alan Reed's illness is forcing the Scottish group to cease live performances.
items._cn_summary: 这是苏格兰老牌乐队PALLAS的第九张录音室专辑，延续了乐队自80年代以来的交响前卫摇滚路线。专辑以圣经、政治、科技及全球冲突等主题为切入点，探讨新闻头条背后的人性、情感与内心世界。音乐上以四人全员参与主唱与和声为特色，吉他在不插电与强力riff之间游走，短小精悍的开场曲与超过八分钟的长篇叙事交替推进。后半部三首作品占据专辑总时长三分之一，被作者视为该流派最高水准的展现。整体呈现出一张结构严谨、回归传统交响前卫摇滚语法的作品，技法成熟但缺乏对其核心听众圈层以外的突破。

items.excerpt: エミル・パリジャン、タブラと交わる新作『Floating』 ヨーロッパジャズのソプラノサックス奏者として25年のキャリアを築いてきたエミル・パリジャンが、ACTレーベルから新作『Floating』をリリースした。ピアノのヤロン・ハーマン、ベースのリンダ・メイ・ハン・オー、そしてタブラ奏者プラブ・エドゥアールとの共演による本作は、古典音楽から世界音楽まで幅広い影響を吸収してきたパリジャンの語法が、非西洋の打楽器といかに対話するかを示す一枚だ。 France Musiqueのポッドキャストで語られた制作の背景によれば、この邂逅は偶発的なコラボレーションというより、長年培われてきた音楽的語彙の延長線上にあるという。ジャズがヨーロッパの文脈でどう自己更新を続けてきたか、その現在地を示す作品とも言えるだろう。 出典：https://www.radiofrance.fr/francemusique/podcasts/au-coeur-du-jazz/emile-parisien-6403447 コルトレーン生誕100年に、マルサリスとリーヴスが応えた新作 ジョン・コルトレーン生誕100周年を記念し
items.body: エミル・パリジャン、タブラと交わる新作『Floating』 ヨーロッパジャズのソプラノサックス奏者として25年のキャリアを築いてきたエミル・パリジャンが、ACTレーベルから新作『Floating』をリリースした。ピアノのヤロン・ハーマン、ベースのリンダ・メイ・ハン・オー、そしてタブラ奏者プラブ・エドゥアールとの共演による本作は、古典音楽から世界音楽まで幅広い影響を吸収してきたパリジャンの語法が、非西洋の打楽器といかに対話するかを示す一枚だ。 France Musiqueのポッドキャストで語られた制作の背景によれば、この邂逅は偶発的なコラボレーションというより、長年培われてきた音楽的語彙の延長線上にあるという。ジャズがヨーロッパの文脈でどう自己更新を続けてきたか、その現在地を示す作品とも言えるだろう。 出典：https://www.radiofrance.fr/francemusique/podcasts/au-coeur-du-jazz/emile-parisien-6403447 コルトレーン生誕100年に、マルサリスとリーヴスが応えた新作 ジョン・コルトレーン生誕100周年を記念し、ブランフォード・マルサリス四重奏団とヴォーカリストのディアンヌ・リーヴスが、Blue Noteから新作『Dedicated To You』をリリースした。企画の出発点にあるのは、1963年の名盤『John Coltrane and Johnny Hartman』——テナーサックスとバラード・ヴォーカルという編成そのものを引き継ぎながら、長年の相棒であるピアニスト、ジョーイ・カルデラッツォらとの即興的なアレンジ作業を通じて、バラード解釈を更新したという。 生誕100年という節目に、過去の名盤をなぞるのではなく、その成り立ちに立ち返って新たな即興性を持ち込んだ点に、今回の企画の芯があるとも言える。既存の敬意の示し方とは異なる道を選んだ一枚として、聴き比べる価値がありそうだ。 出典：https://www.radiofrance.fr/francemusique/podcasts/au-coeur-du-jazz/branford-marsalis-quartet-dianne-reeves-eternellement-coltrane-8964069 ビートメイカー、キーファーがBlue Noteからデビュー ロサンゼルスのビート・カルチャーと結びつきの深いビートメイカー、キーファーが、名門Blue Noteから『Memory Bomb』と題したデビューアルバムをリリースした。ジャズとヒップホップ、ロサンゼルスのビート・カルチャーを融合させた作品で、ジャジーヒップホップの現在地を示す一枚として評されている。Blue Noteという老舗レーベルがビートメイカーの作品を迎え入れた背景について、今後の展開にも注視したい一作だ。 出典：https://glidemagazine.com/330465/kiefer-turns-jazz-hip-hop-and-l-a-beat-culture-into-blue-note-debut-titled-memory-bomb-album-review ニューオーリンズ、音と食が共存する理由 米国ニューオーリンズで、音楽と料理に関わる2人の共著による新刊『Rhythm & Roux』が出版された。著者のブライアン・ランドリーとピーター・ハリスは、著名なシェフと卓越した音楽家のコンビだ。 ニューオーリンズでは、音楽と食が別々の娯楽としてではなく、同じ場所・同じ共同体の記憶として息づいてきた。本書はその結びつきを、単なる郷土料理本としてではなく、ニューオーリンズの食と音楽がどのように共に進化してきたのかを描き出す。 items.body: Novena Senda releases the single and music video “A la deriva”, the first preview of the Barcelona band’s second album. The song moves between darkwave and the Spanish-language rock of Héroes del Silencio, wrapped in an atmosphere the band ties to the 1980s and 1990s. “A la deriva” deals with exhaustion and the feeling of being lost. It follows Novena Senda’s 2022 debut album “Laberinto de Voces”, the record that established the band’s sound between darkwave and Spanish-language rock, with echoes of Depeche Mode and Héroes del Silencio. About Novena Senda The band formed in Barcelona in 2017, with Lorenzo Ferrer, Edu Migueles and David Arroyo making up the band. Their 2022 debut album “Laberinto de Voces” set out the sound they have built on since: darkwave merged with Spanish-language rock, carrying an atmosphere that nods to Depeche Mode and Héroes del Silencio. “A la deriva”, released in 2026, is the first single from the follow-up to that debut, with the rest of the album still to come.

items.album: Sevit releases long-shelved album ‘Requiem’
items.excerpt: Sevit released “Requiem”, a darkwave album the Dallas-area duo wrote as the follow-up to 2021’s “On The Edge Of A Darker Place,” on 1 October 2026. The nine-track record sat unfinished for years, surfacing only after a self-titled Sevit album filled the gap in 2024. “Requiem” runs nine tracks: Ode To A Requiem Beyond My Control Escape Dreamland In So Many Words It Must Be Berlin Until Sundown The Happy Crowd The Walls Are Closing In (Original Version) Re
items.body: Sevit released “Requiem”, a darkwave album the Dallas-area duo wrote as the follow-up to 2021’s “On The Edge Of A Darker Place,” on 1 October 2026. The nine-track record sat unfinished for years, surfacing only after a self-titled Sevit album filled the gap in 2024. “Requiem” runs nine tracks: Ode To A Requiem Beyond My Control Escape Dreamland In So Many Words It Must Be Berlin Until Sundown The Happy Crowd The Walls Are Closing In (Original Version) Requiem Requiem by Sevit Sevit have not detailed why the record was set aside, but the band summed up the gap in one line: “Maybe some records simply have to wait until the people who created them finally catch up with them.” Sevit’s ‘Requiem’ follows ‘On The Edge Of A Darker Place’ “Requiem” is out now on Bandcamp as a digital release. About Sevit Jackie Legos (vocals, guitar) and Cam B. (synths, programming) write and record Sevit from the Dallas, Texas area, where the duo formed in 2020 after both had played in earlier North Texas bands, including At Night and Pleasure Crisis. They issued the “A Darker Place” EP that same year and signed to Peru’s InClub Records that October. Sevit’s debut album, “On The Edge Of A Darker Place,” arrived in September 2021: thirteen tracks that draw on The Cure, Joy Division, Bauhaus and Siouxsie & The Banshees, played live by a five-piece band built around the Legos and Cam B. core. Jackie Legos has described the band’s lyrics as rooted in “poetry, and things that might have directly and indirectly crossed my path in life.” The duo wrote “Requiem” as that album’s direct sequel, then set it aside. A self-titled album filled the gap in 2024. “Requiem” finally surfaces, closing a chapter the band had otherwise left open.
items._cn_summary: Sevit由来自达拉斯地区的Jackie Legos和Cam B.组成，是一支典型的暗潮二人组，作品风格受The Cure、Joy Division、Bauhaus及Siouxsie & The Banshees等后朋克与哥特经典乐队影响。《Requiem》原计划作为2021年专辑《On The Edge Of A Darker Place》的直接续作，但搁置多年后才于2026年正式发行，中间由2024年的同名专辑填补空档。整张专辑共九首曲目，以人声、吉他与合成器编程为核心，延续了传统暗潮的忧郁氛围与暗黑美学。文章本质上是一篇新闻发布稿，侧重发行信息和乐队背景介绍，缺乏对音乐本体如编曲结构、声音设计或情感表达的具体评论，未能提供深入的艺术分析或聆听价值判断。

items.body: Miss Construction returns with “This Is Crap”, a new EBM and industrial-electro album that pairs eleven new tracks with a reissue of the project’s 2008 debut. Out 27 November 2026 on Out Of Line as a 2CD digipak, it follows “Boys & Ladies”, the sixth single, released 30 September. Disc one holds the eleven new tracks: This Is Crap (Intro) 6666 Heiß Hate Spiel Mit Mir Back Again F.M.P. Boys & Ladies This Is War Bully Du This Is Crap by Miss Construction Disc two reissues “Kunstprodukt,” Miss Construction’s debut album, originally released 28 April 2008 on Fear Section. It adds two archival remixes to the original sixteen tracks: the title track remixed by Gintronic, and “Electro Beast” remixed by Dolls Of Pain. “Boys & Ladies” arrived as an official video through Out Of Line Music’s YouTube channel on 30 September, embedded below. Miss Construction’s road back to ‘This Is Crap’ “Boys & Ladies” caps a run of five singles that marked Miss Construction’s return: “Spiel Mit Mir” in October 2025, “Back Again” in December 2025, then “Heiß,” “Hate” and “F.M.P.” through 2026. “This Is Crap” is available to pre-order now through the Out Of Line shop and on Bandcamp. About Miss Construction Miss Construction began in 2008 as a side project of Chris Pohl, who had fronted Blutengel since 1996. Pohl brought in Gordon Mocznay as co-vocalist, and the pair debuted the project at Wave-Gotik-Treffen in Leipzig that year. Its opening statement was a cover of Terminal Choice’s “Totes Fleisch,” placed on the debut album “Kunstprodukt,” released 28 April 2008 on Fear Section, an Out Of Line sublabel. Pohl and Mocznay followed it with “United Trash – The Z Files” in November 2013. Between full-lengths, Miss Construction contributed remixes to Blutengel and Dance Or Die compilations between 2009 and 2011, including the “Awake The Machines” and “Industrial For The Masses” series, before the project went quiet for twelve years. Pohl revived Miss Construction in 2025. “Spiel Mit Mir” opened the comeback that October, “Back Again” followed in December, and “Heiß,” “Hate,” “F.M.P.” and “Boys & Ladies” continued it through 2026. “This Is Crap” closes that run of singles and gives “Kunstprodukt” its first reissue.

items.body: Corlyx released “The Holy Vampire” on 1 October 2026, the fourth single from “The Crimson Tapes,” the darkwave trio’s next album due in early 2027 on Out Of Line Music. Guitarist and producer Brandon Ashley made the track with singer Caitlin Stokes, who also directed and edited its companion video alongside Sereina Winters. Ashley called the track’s tone deliberate: “It’s also quite camp, which Corlyx is a huge fan of.” He placed it close to 2025’s “Purple Pain,” pairing dancefloor elements with a harder deathrock edge than that album. Corlyx’s ‘The Holy Vampire’ leads to ‘The Crimson Tapes’ “The Holy Vampire” is streaming now and available on Bandcamp. About Corlyx Corlyx call their sound “Death Pop,” a label singer Caitlin Stokes coined for a mix of 1980s post-punk and goth rock. The band started in Los Angeles, releasing its first single, “Starlet,” in February 2016, and now splits its time between the UK and Italy, where Stokes works with guitarist and producer Brandon Ashley and bassist Davide Rocco. Corlyx’s video for “Twist Like An Animal” arrived in 2019. The band announced the album “Blood In The Disco” in 2021 behind the single “Take Off Everything,” then returned in 2024 with “Zombie Kid” ahead of the double album “Purple Pain” the following year. Corlyx has toured Europe, the UK and the US with Lord Of The Lost, Massive Ego, Ashbury Heights, Blutengel and Twin Tribes. “Sweeter Than Blood,” “More Anarchy” and “Your Heart In The Serpent’s Mouth” preceded “The Holy Vampire” as the first three singles from “The Crimson Tapes.”
items._cn_summary: 本文为单曲发行新闻稿，介绍Corlyx乐队2026年10月发布的新单曲《The Holy Vampire》，这是其即将于2027年初通过Out Of Line Music厂牌发行的专辑《The Crimson Tapes》的第四支单曲。文章引用了吉他手兼制作人Brandon Ashley的简短陈述，指出该曲带有刻意的夸张戏剧感，在舞池元素的基础上融入了比2025年专辑《Purple Pain》更硬朗的死亡摇滚棱角。文中还回顾了乐队自2016年于洛杉矶成立以来从首支单曲《Starlet》到双专辑《Purple Pain》的历程，强调其自称的"Death Pop"风格融合了1980年代后朋克与哥特摇滚。文章本质上是厂牌通稿性质，未涉及深入的音乐分析或审美评论。
