items.body:
Sometime in 1986, perhaps in a Paris caf�, Dominique Cravic, a singer, guitarist, and musical archivist, met Robert Crumb, an underground cartoonist, banjo and mandolin player, and jug-band aficionado. Over a few glasses of marc, to continue to speculate, they conjured up the idea for Les Primitifs du futur.  Since then, they have recorded an impossible-to-categorize series of albums, with cover illustrations by Crumb, of which Les Crimes du Mussette is the fifth.
Weird and wonderful, it sounds like they rooted through an attic full of 78 RPM records, scribbled down some arrangements, and then played them on a collection of instruments they found in another attic, including accordion, sax, xylophone, clarinet, banjo, ukulele, theremin, Hawaiian guitar, bagpipe chanter (I�m guessing here), and musical saw.
Ne tirez pas sur le pianiste (excerpt)
The 27 short tracks are mostly voiced by Cravic, who talk-sings in the manner of an everyman Maurice Chevalier. He is often accompanied by the accordion, a customary instrument in the bal-musette style that remains a strong element of the eclectic range of styles they have managed to synthesize. They also include ragtime, jug, French chanson, and, to my ears, skiffle,  just to get the list started.
Ukulele Lady (excerpt)
The liner notes point out that �Les Crimes du Musette is also a gold mine for scholars, a veritable treasure trove.� Exploring the treasures is beyond my scope here, as each tune has a long history. A highlight for me is the humorous �Ukulele Lady� from 1925, which first delighted me on Arlo Guthrie�s 1971 album
Hobo�s Lullaby
. The song has also been covered by Bing Crosby, Peter Sellers, and Bette Midler.
N'oublie pas Gr�co (excerpt)
A more serious item is �N�oublie pas Gr�co� (Don�t Forget Gr�co�)  is a tribute to the legendary chanteuse and heroine of the French Resistance, Juliette Gr�co, who died in 2020. You will also hear old chestnuts like �Fum�e aux yeux� (�Smoke Gets in Your Eyes�),  �Boude pas� (�Take Five�), and �Prive d�amour� (�As Time Goes By�).
This record is a curiosity, but it is performed by serious musicians with total commitment. In this, I was reminded of the similarly indefinable Dan Hicks & the Hot Licks. Long-forgotten music and abandoned styles are given new animation with obvious enthusiasm and care. Speaking about himself and his collaborators, many of whom are in their seventies, Dominique Cravic says, �The young have fire, but we have light.� In its own little corner,
Les Crimes du Musette
shines bright.

items.body:
Tiny Sun creates tiny songs that give off light and heat well out of proportion to their size. Composed, performed, and produced by Martina Sorbara, Jonathan Goldsmith, and Don Rooke, the record is vaguely Americana, with plucked guitars and ukuleles, chiming keyboards, and the lonesome slide of the guitar.
Vanishment
contains eighteen sparkling miniatures - that take a scant 34 minutes to negotiate - notable for their economy of arrangement and the subtle directness of the lyrics. The tracks glow with Martina�s clear, high, and sometimes fragile voice.
The songs are about loss: lost love, lost confidence, but sometimes about resignation to the enigmatic quirks of the world. The tone of wry fatalism mirrors the fact that this project is the work of many years of collaboration and email exchanges while the trio pursued their musical day jobs. Jonathan Goldsmith is an award-winning composer for television and film, Don Rooke fronts the Toronto roots band The Henrys, and Martina Sorbara is known for folk, electropop, and her band Dragonette.
Kerosene Madrigal
The range of backgrounds leads to many styles, and the record betrays interesting influences. The opening track, �Kerosene Madrigal,� is a sort of miner�s blues reminiscent of Michelle Shocked. The soul-country of �Imagined Love� reminded me of fellow Torontonians Cowboy Junkies, especially the sweet organ. The stoic and twangy �Don�t Fault the Stars for Falling� could have been a Dolly Parton tune.
A Grand Expanse
�A Grand Expanse� has a more ambitious arrangement.  It sounds like the end-credits song from a long-ago film we only vaguely remember. It says everything it needs to in one minute and twenty seconds and exactly 38 words. It is quintessential Tiny Sun.
The entire recording feels like music from a dream, and since no one knows exactly what dream music sounds like, this could be it.
Berceuse
Tiny Sun will perform the entire album at Toronto�s Koerner Hall on May 14, 2026.

items._cn_summary: 这是一张由三位多伦多音乐人通过多年邮件合作完成的专辑，收录了十八首短小精悍的歌曲，总时长仅三十四分钟。制作采用原声吉他、尤克里里、键盘与滑棒吉他等简约配器，呈现出清淡的美式民谣色调。歌词围绕失去与无奈展开，Martina Sorbara清亮而脆弱的嗓音成为贯穿全作的核心质感。曲目风格跨度较大，从矿工蓝调、灵魂乡村到怀旧电影配乐式的抒情小品均有触及。整体氛围如同梦境中的音乐，编排克制，词作直白。虽然三人各自拥有独立厂牌经验与跨界背景，但成品倾向于温暖细腻的独立民谣路线，在实验性、声景设计与跨类型融合方面着墨有限，与偏好前沿声响与即兴结构的聆听取向之间存在较大距离。

items.body: Review by A Crimson Mellotron — 'One Among the Living' is the fourth studio album released by Canadian band Mystery, and to this dayit remains one of their most appreciated and recognizable works. A complex conceptual record, thiselegantly arranged LP offers a melodically-inclined style of neo-progressive rock that is informedboth by the genre's progenitors, and by the glamorous sounds of the 80s AOR/pop rock scene in theUK. Fans of contemporary neo-prog shall recognize many of the traits shared by bands like Pendragon,Galahad, and Arena, in the melodic guitars, opulent keyboard textures, and that fine blend betweensymphonic music and traditional rock instrumentation.The arrangements are intricate and the soundscapes are lush, while the overall atmosphere of 'One Among the Living' seems to be brooding, epic, and even theatrical. And while there certainly are strong ideas with solid execution, 'OneAmong the Living' often feels like something you have already heard, offering familiar sounds thatperfectly fit the neo-prog landscape of the late 2000s. I lack a bit of edge and novelty with thisalbum, even if the emotionally-loaded performances of singer Benoît David are tremendous and praise-worthy. The songs 'Wolf', 'The Falling Man' and the title track might be the strongest entries here,whereas most instrumental sections in 'Till the Truth Comes Out' and 'Through Different Eyes' arequite excellent, too. The rest is way too mellow for my taste, but enjoyers of the neo-prog subgenrewill definitely have plenty of gorgeous material to explore on this 2010 Unicorn Digital release.
items._cn_summary: 这张2010年发行的专辑是加拿大乐队Mystery的第四张录音室作品，属于新前卫摇滚范畴。编曲精致繁复，键盘音色层次丰富，旋律吉他与交响化元素交织，营造出阴郁、史诗且戏剧化的整体氛围。制作深受英国八十年代AOR流行摇滚影响，呈现出华丽饱满的音色质感。评论指出作品执行扎实但缺乏新意，听感熟悉，与同时期新前卫流派风格高度重合。主唱Bénoit David情感充沛的演绎是亮点，曲目《Wolf》《The Falling Man》及同名曲被视为最强之作，《Till the Truth Comes Out》与《Through Different Eyes》中的器乐段落同样出色，其余部分则偏向柔和内敛。整体属于流派内的标准作品，与实验、前卫或电子方向距离较远。

items._cn_summary: Stef Chura 是来自底特律的音乐人，这张《Dancing Alone on the Concrete》是她的第三张全长专辑，乐评仅以'torchy'（一种带有感性情绪的独立摇滚/民谣摇滚风格）一笔带过，未提供具体的音乐细节或制作分析。从可用信息来看，这是一张偏向主流独立摇滚领域的作品，与实验、前卫、爵士、电子或暗潮等用户偏好的方向相去甚远。原文内容极短，属于纯新闻摘要性质，缺乏深入的乐评视角，无法判断其艺术深度或创新程度。该专辑对寻求前卫、实验性或跨界融合声音的听众而言，相关性较低。

items.body: The new release will feature remastered audio, rarities and unreleased live recordings Talking Heads' 1979 album Fear Of Music is getting a super deluxe edition reissue. The classic album will be newly made available in 2xLP and 6xLP vinyl editions, as well as on 3xCD/Blu-ray. Both vinyl releases will feature the full original album in remastered form, as well as a collection of rarities. The more extensive vinyl edition will also take in unreleased audio from concerts that the band performed during the Fear Of Music era in Boston and New Jersey. The post Talking Heads’ ‘Fear Of Music’ Set for Super Deluxe Reissue appeared first on The Quietus.
items._cn_summary: 本文为Talking Heads 1979年专辑《Fear Of Music》超级豪华版再发行的新闻通告。内容介绍再版将提供全新母带重制的音频，包含稀有曲目与未发行现场录音，分别以双LP、六LP及三CD加蓝光形式发行。蓝光版包含杜比全景声、5.1环绕声及高解析立体声混音，并附乐队在波士顿与新泽西演出期间的稀有影像片段。文章主体为发行资讯通报，未涉及音乐本身的艺术分析、制作理念或与同年代作品的历史定位讨论，偏向厂牌宣传性质。Talking Heads虽具备一定的艺术摇滚与后朋克实验倾向，但本文并未呈现任何对其音乐语言的深度评述，信息量有限。

Choices vary, but it feels inarguable that Elastica – and Elastica – remain the coolest in all the above categories. The four-piece were cemented as elegant, eternal stars on their self-titled 1995 debut album: a collection of short, sharp songs, with equally short, sharp haircuts on the cover. Like the supernatural pop ideal immortalised in 1998’s Velvet Goldmine – a film they cameoed in – Elastica came from London but also seemingly arrived fully formed from another, sexier, less effortful dimension. items.body: Disorder Festival, a new two-day event dedicated to the international goth, coldwave, darkwave, post-punk and EBM scenes, takes place in Montreuil, just outside Paris, on 6 and 7 February 2027. The festival spreads across four venues in the same neighbourhood instead of a single site: La Marbrerie, Le Chinois, Le Bal Chavaux and La Bicyclette. The first fifteen acts have already been announced, among them Martin Dupont, Frustration and David Shaw & The Beat, with more names still to come. A further wave of artists is due to be revealed on 30 October. Some artists will be available for interviews, and press and photo accreditation can be arranged through the festival’s local PR, Take Me Out. About Disorder Festival Disorder is a new festival built around the international goth, coldwave, darkwave, post-punk and EBM scenes, set to debut in Montreuil on 6 and 7 February 2027. The organisers are spreading the event across four venues in the same part of Montreuil instead of concentrating it in one site: La Marbrerie, Le Chinois, Le Bal Chavaux and La Bicyclette. The first confirmed names include Martin Dupont, Frustration and David Shaw & The Beat, with the remainder of the fifteen-act first wave and a further round of bookings still to be made public.
items._cn_summary: 这是一篇关于2027年新音乐节Disorder Festival的官方新闻稿，介绍该活动将在巴黎郊区蒙特勒伊举办，跨越四个场地，包括La Marbrerie、Le Chinois、Le Bal Chavaux和La Bicyclette。第一批公布的十五组艺人包括Martin Dupont、Frustration和David Shaw & The Beat等，更多阵容将于10月30日公布。主办方为本地公关公司Take Me Out，可安排采访和媒体证。内容纯粹是活动信息公告，并非音乐评论或艺术分析，没有涉及任何音乐风格、声响设计或艺术价值的讨论。作为用户最关注的暗潮/EBM类型，活动本身有一定相关性，但作为乐评内容，信息量严重不足。

items.body: Assemblage 23 releases “Believe (INHALT Remix)” on 2 October 2026 via Metropolis Records. The single reworks “Believe”, the opening track from Tom Shear’s tenth Assemblage 23 album “Null”, released in November 2025. The remix comes from US producer Matia Simovich, who records as INHALT. “In INHALT’s expert hands, this song has been transformed. It has one foot on the mid-’80s dancefloor and the other planted firmly in the future,” Shear says of the rework. Believe (INHALT Remix) by Assemblage 23 “Believe” first appeared on “Null”, which Shear promoted with a UK tour ahead of its release and a run of sold-out shows in Germany. He returns to Europe this October for further dates in Germany and Sweden, several of which are already sold out. “‘Believe’ is about a hope for better things, even with the state of the world as it is today,” Shear said when the song first came out. “We are responsible for making the kind of world we live in. In the face of bad times, sometimes the most subversive thing you can do is to have hope.” Assemblage 23 live dates, October 2026 20 October – Karlsruhe, Die Stadtmitte (Germany) 21 October – Oberhausen, Kulttempel (Germany) 22 October – Hamburg, Indra Musikclub (Germany) 23 October – Jönköping, SekktorF (Sweden) – sold out 24 October – Hannover, Subkultur (Germany) – sold out Remaining tickets are available through the Assemblage 23 website. About Assemblage 23 Assemblage 23 is the recording name of US producer and songwriter Tom Shear, active since the late 1990s. His debut album “Contempt” placed him at the front of the electro-industrial and Future Pop scene that took hold on underground dancefloors at the turn of the millennium. Side-Line interviewed Shear about his long career and songwriting process. “Null”, Shear’s tenth album as Assemblage 23, was announced for Metropolis Records and released on 7 November 2025, led by the single “Tolerate”. Shear’s lyrics have long dealt directly with difficult personal subjects, including suicide and depression, a directness that has built him a following that keeps him touring regularly. “Believe (INHALT Remix)”, out 2 October 2026, pairs the “Null” opener with a rework by Matia Simovich (INHALT) ahead of Assemblage 23’s latest run of European dates.
items._cn_summary: Assemblage 23由美国制作人Tom Shear主持，自1990年代末活跃于电子工业和未来流行领域，2025年11月发行第十张专辑《Null》，其中收录歌曲"Believe"表达对世界的希望态度。本次INHALT（制作人Matia Simovich）的混音版于2026年10月2日由Metropolis Records发行，将原作置于80年代中期舞曲与未来风格的交汇点。本文本质为单曲发行的新闻通稿，介绍混音来源、原专辑背景、欧洲巡演日程及艺人简介等内容，对混音的音乐技法、声响设计或创新性未做任何实质性的分析或评价，信息偏向宣传性质而非乐评。

items.body: Swedish synthpop act Split Vision release the single “Cold War” on 2 October 2026 through the Danish label Town And Towers Records. The track is the second single from the band’s upcoming album “BetaCity”, due on 6 November 2026 on streaming, CD and vinyl. “Cold War” follows “Out of Nowhere”, released on 10 September 2026 as the first single from “BetaCity.” The new track moves into darker territory than its predecessor. Sequenced synthesizers underpin lyrics that revisit Cold War-era paranoia, isolation and secrecy as a metaphor for conflict and uncertainty. The lyrics were written by the band’s label manager, Stig Wintendorff, in the 1980s. The chorus repeats the song’s central image: “Dancing in the shadows of the Cold War night.” The single’s cover artwork draws on Cold War-era imagery: masks, military hardware and Soviet-style visual motifs. Split Vision’s ‘BetaCity’ album Split Vision’s previous album, “Echoes of a New Spell” (2025, Town And Towers Records), drew on the synthesizers and recording approach associated with early Depeche Mode. “BetaCity” turns instead toward the early sound of Alphaville. Town And Towers Records describes the album’s sound as combining “warm analogue synthesizers with colder digital textures, wavetable sounds, sequenced bass lines and atmospheric pads.” Recommended for fans of Alphaville, Depeche Mode and Erasure. About Split Vision Split Vision formed in Sweden in 1985, when two teenage friends started writing synthpop with influences from Depeche Mode, Yazoo, Erasure and Pet Shop Boys. Two more members joined, and the four-piece played discotheques in North Eastern Skåne and appeared on regional radio and talent shows through the late 1980s. Platinum Records released the single “How Will I Ever” in 1988, and “So Many Times” became a minor hit in Sweden before the group disbanded. Dan Hansson and Henric Palmqvist, two of the original members, restarted Split Vision in the spring of 2019 to write new material rooted in the band’s 1980s sound. “We wanted to take the audience on a journey back to carefully carved arpeggios, that smell of Moog and Yamaha DX-7,” the band said of that return, describing music with “strong melodies performed by a distinct lead and backed by a contemporary vocoder.” The result, “Among the Stars,” arrived on 1 October 2020, with lyrics and soundscapes that reference the cosmos. Split Vision signed to the Scandinavian label Town And Towers Records in 2022 and has released several singles and EPs since. A music video for “Lust,” directed by Norwegian filmmaker Öystein Thorsen, followed in August 2024 and won awards at the New York Tri-State International Film Festival and the KHIFF Krimson Horyzon International Film Festival in India. The band has also toured as a support act for the British group China Crisis. “Echoes of a New Spell” followed in 2025, and “Out of Nowhere” opened the “BetaCity” campaign on 10 September 2026. “Cold War,” released 2 October 2026, is the second single from that album, due on 6 November 2026 through Town And Towers Records.
items._cn_summary: 瑞典合成器流行乐队 Split Vision 发布新单曲《Cold War》，为其即将于2026年11月发行的专辑《BetaCity》预热。歌曲以冷战时期的偏执、孤立与秘密为隐喻，副歌重复'在冷战之夜的阴影中起舞'。编曲采用序列合成器支撑歌词，封面设计融入面具、军事装备及苏联视觉元素。相比前作致敬早期 Depeche Mode 风格，新专辑转向 Alphaville 式声音美学，结合温暖的模拟合成器与冷冽的数字纹理、波形表音色、序列贝斯线及氛围铺底。该乐队1985年成立，2019年重组，以80年代合成器流行为根基复出。文章本质为厂牌宣传新闻稿，缺乏独立音乐评论视角。

items.body: 会期：2026/09/05～2026/11/08 会場：The Mass［東京都］ 公式サイト：http://themass.jp/gallery1/ 1972年アムステルダム生まれの写真家ヴィヴィアン・サッセンは、2000年代初頭よりファッション写真とアートフォトの領域を横断しながら、身体や視線をめぐるファッション写真の規範とジェンダーバイアスを独自の視覚言語によって捉え直してきた先駆的な作家である。The Massで開催中の個展「Myriads」は、そうしたサッセンの現在進行形の探求を捉えるまたとない機会となっている。 本展より［筆者撮影］ サッセンのビジュアル言語を形づくってきたのは、幼少期を過ごしたケニアで経験した強い光がもたらす陰影である。後年の作品においてもケープタウンやザンビア、ナミビアといったアフリカ各地の強い日差しによる鋭い陰影と鮮やかな色彩が繰り返し現われ、そこに躍動的でいびつなポージングやコラージュといった操作が加わることで、身体は断片化された形態へと変容していく。隠された顔や切断された身体、人工物や幾何学図形と自然との対比に見られるシュルレアリスム的な操作は、ファッション写真によって画一的に扱われてきた身体を抽象化し、固有のアイデンティティから遠ざけていく。その一方で綿密に構築された演出的な構図にはスナップショットのような瞬間性が同居し、撮影者と被写体のあいだに生じる関係や親密さが画面に築かれている。 こうした身体表現の背景には、サッセン自身が学生時代にモデルとして活動した経験がある。伝統的なファッション写真において女性の身体は理想化され、見る側の欲望に応える耽美な記号として消費されてきた。サッセンはその「見る・見られる」という非対称な関係への違和感から、男性写真家に向けられてきた視線に抗うように身体を解体し、非象徴的でオブジェクトにも似た特異な像へと組み替えていく。 本展より［筆者撮影］ 写真家とモデルのあいだに生じるこうした視線の力学は、コリエ・ショア、ロー・エスリッジ、トールビョルン・ロードランドといった、アートと商業写真の領域を往還してきた同世代のファッション写真家たちによる編集的なイメージの実践とも接点を持つ。ここでいう同時代性とは、ショアが代表作「Jens F.」（2005）において規範的なポーズを基にモデルの性別や関係性を入れ替え、見る者と見られる者の視線が複雑に交錯する状況を画面に組み込んだ反復性や、エスリッジが商業誌のために撮影した既発表のイメージを元の文脈から切り離し、新たな並びのなかで再利用することで、写真の価値をイメージそのものではなく構成や反復のうちに生じる奇妙な物語性へと移し替えていく方法に見出すことができる。そこでは一貫した物語によって全体性を構築するのではなく、個々のイメージが置かれる文脈を視覚的かつ意図的にずらすことで、断片的でアイロニカルな魅力が生まれている。欲望やジェンダー・アイデンティティを画面内部で直接的に象徴化せず、画面の外にある対象やコンテキストを偶然として意図的に演出することで意味を揺さぶるサッセンの作風も、こうしたエディトリアルな構成を伴う現代ファッション写真の系譜に連なるものとして読むことができる。 本展より［筆者撮影］ さらに特筆すべきは、強い色彩やポージングによって像を構成する手法と、鏡やアクリル板による反射や屈折を利用した光学的な操作とがサッセンの制作において等価に扱われている点である。身体やプロップ、ペイント、鏡といった異なる要素はいずれも光によって像を形成するための素材として画面に組み込まれており、カメラを介さず物体を印画紙に直接置いて像を定着させるフォトグラムに通ずる同じ原理を、プロップやペイントによるコラージュ的な操作という別の手つきによって展開しているともいえる。こうした実験性は、1920年代にモホリ゠ナジらがニュー・ヴィジョンのもとで、極端なアングルや光学実験を通して写真の知覚を更新しようとした実践とも呼応する。しかしサッセンの場合、その形式的な実験はファッション写真におけるイメージの消費や身体表象の政治性と結びつくことで、見るという行為そのものを不安定なものとして演出し、鑑賞者の視点を揺さぶるのである。 本展より［筆者撮影］ 鑑賞日：2026/09/20（日）

items._cn_summary: 本文并非乐评，而是关于摄影师薇薇安·萨森个展「Myriads」的展评。文章围绕其在肯尼亚成长的经历所形成的强烈光影语言展开，论述其如何通过碎片化身体、反常姿态与反射材料构建超越性别刻板的视觉体系。评论将其置于柯利·肖尔、劳·埃斯利奇等同时代时尚摄影师的脉络中，分析其通过偶然性构图与反讽式编辑手法对凝视政治的重构，并追溯至莫霍利-纳吉时代的光学实验传统。文章学术性强，视野开阔，但与用户关注的实验音乐、电子、暗潮等方向几乎无关。

items.excerpt: ヴェテランUKロック・バンドによる6年ぶりのニュー・アルバム。オノ・ヨーコのアート作品に影響を受け作られたという曲群は、壮大な音像が耳に残る。開放的なシンセが鳴り響く“Black Sage”を筆頭に、多くの音を編んだ綿密な曲作りの妙が際立つ。クイーン的なコーラス・ワークが光る“Doomsday Waltz”など、随所で古のUKロックを感じさせるのも特徴だ。

items._cn_summary: Mystery Jets时隔六年推出的新专辑，创作灵感来自小野洋子的艺术作品。专辑以开阔的合成器音色为特征，编曲绵密繁复，层次丰富。代表曲目如《Black Sage》展现了宏大的声场构建，而《Doomsday Waltz》则呈现出Queen式的合唱编排。整体听感偏向传统英伦摇滚脉络，作品在合成器运用与经典摇滚元素之间寻求平衡，风格沉稳内敛。虽然制作精良，但音乐语言相对传统，更注重氛围营造与旋律展开，而非前卫实验或突破性声音设计。

items.body:
Live at Rockpalast 1999
documents a command performance at the Loreley open-air amphitheater by Malcolm �Mac� Rebennack Jr., aka Dr. John. Rockpalast is a live-music TV show broadcast since 1974 by Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR), the archival source for this CD-DVD package, and coincidentally a remarkable cultural institution on its own terms.
Taped at the height of Dr. John�s international popularity, backing the singer-pianist-guitarist are New Orleans stalwarts Bobby Broom (guitar), David Barard (bass), and Herman Ernest (drums), a tight quartet that projects authority and engages the crowd from start to close.
A striking UNESCO-designated World Heritage Site set, the Loreley is a slate pinnacle on a mythic horseshoe bend of the Rhine River, memorializing an enduring German literary legend both tragic and romantic. The setting is thus well-suited for Mac�s mystical spirit and lyrical style. By this stage of his career, he characterized his live show as a Mardi Gras revue with a mix of New Orleans standards and some of his most recognizable compositions.
Hence, he opens with the NOLA classic �Iko, Iko,� a half-sung, half-chanted celebration of community participation in the renowned Mardi Gras second-line street procession. Then comes the in-your-face boast �Qualified,� wherein the singer warns, �I got the power to control / I can see clean through you, blind mole / I want to tell you now, I'm qualified / You know that I'm qualified.�
Any Dr. John fan will recognize �I Walk on Guilded Splinters,� a moody, percussively insistent, foreboding expression of the Night Tripper�s immersion in �funknology� (his term), gris-gris herbology, and hoodoo incantation, punctuated with jungle growls and cries, a loopy, spooky slide whistle, and an extended psych-guitar solo: �Walk thru the fire / Fly thru the smoke / See my enemy / At the end of dey rope.�
Every piece in this well- honed set deserves considertion. Although Dr John lived for many years in Los Angeles and New York, his enduring hometown connection shows in the fond inclusion of his own �Sweet Home New Orleans� and �Goin� Back to New Orleans,� and he nods to a key influence with a funky rendering of Duke Ellington�s �I'm Gonna Go Fishin�.� Among other gems are Mac�s Top�10 hit �Right Place, Wrong Time,� and the instantly recognizable closer, Earl King�s �Big Chief,� another Mardi Gras burner.
Regarding his live performance approach, per the notes, �I always play a little bit of everything. I think that�s what music�s about: a little bit of somethin� old, somethin� in the middle, somethin� new, and somethin� as yet uncreated.�
Dr John's�s longtime fans will welcome this archival gem, which also is a solid introduction for any late comers to the party. Surmounting the barriers of language and culture, the power of
At the Rockpalast
is also evident in the enthusiastic audience response. As he declares, �If you�re gonna get off on somethin� you don�t need to know nothin� about it. Music is a universal language.�

items._cn_summary: 这张现场专辑记录了Dr. John 1999年在德国莱茵河畔露天剧场的演出，核心曲目围绕新奥尔良传统展开——Mardi Gras游行经典"Iko Iko"、标志性"I Walk on Guilded Splinters"中充满巫毒仪式感的丛林人声与迷幻吉他即兴，加上Fats Domino式的节奏蓝调弹奏。乐评强调其作为新奥尔良音乐大使的角色，提到"funknology"与巫毒草药学的舞台表演美学。伴奏阵容精简，吉他、贝斯与鼓构成紧密四重奏。尽管"funknology"一词暗示了某种实验性意识，但整体内容更接近传统新奥尔良R&B与布鲁斯的庆典式演绎，而非真正意义上的前卫实验。与用户关注的实验、前卫、自由爵士及电子方向存在较大距离。
